title.ja: 初心者にオススメの戦法
title.en: Choosing your first opening

paragraphs.ja: 居飛車は飛車を２筋に残し、飛車と角を同じ方面で働かせる。振り飛車は飛車を左へ移し、空いた右側に玉を囲う。最初は両方を同時に暗記するより、一方の基本形と攻守の役割を理解しよう。居飛車なら矢倉、振り飛車なら四間飛車が入口になる。
paragraphs.en: Choose a family by how you want to coordinate the rook and king. Static Rook keeps the rook on the second file and develops an attack alongside the bishop; Ranging Rook moves it left and usually castles right. Start with Yagura or Fourth-file Rook, learning where each attacking and defending piece belongs rather than collecting opening names.

paragraphs.ja: 相手も自分と同じ戦法を選ぶとは限らない。居飛車なら対振り飛車と角換わり、振り飛車なら相振り飛車と角交換への対応も順に学ぶ。角道を閉じても相手の手順次第では角交換を避けられない。囲いと棒銀など一つの攻め筋をセットで練習し、実戦で崩れた場所を復習しよう。
paragraphs.en: Your opponent determines the next branch. Static Rook players also need anti-ranging development and Bishop Exchange; ranging players need Double Ranging Rook and bishop-exchange responses. A closed bishop diagonal simplifies some positions but does not guarantee a quiet game. Pair one castle with one attack, then review the first point where an opponent prevented your intended formation.

question.ja: 四間飛車を覚えれば、相手が振り飛車でも同じ囲いでよい？
question.en: Can a Fourth-file Rook player use identical development against a ranging opponent?

answer.ja: 相振り飛車では攻めの方向が変わる。対居飛車用の美濃囲いを機械的に使わず、相振りの駒組みを別に学ぶ。
answer.en: No. Double Ranging Rook changes the attack direction; learn its formations instead of automatically repeating anti-Static Rook development.

title.ja: 居飛車定跡の基本
title.en: Understanding Static Rook openings

paragraphs.ja: 居飛車の分岐は大駒の働きで整理できる。飛車先の歩交換は持ち歩を得て飛車の通路を開け、２五へ銀などを進める余地も作る。一方、相手の角や銀が２四を守れば交換できない。角道を開けるか閉じるかも、角交換や乱戦の可能性を変える。
paragraphs.en: Static Rook openings can be understood through two decisions: whether rook-pawn exchanges are allowed and whether the bishop diagonals remain open. Exchanging the rook pawn provides a pawn in hand, opens a rook route and frees the fifth-rank square for another piece. That exchange is unsafe when an opposing bishop or silver controls the rook’s intended capture square.

paragraphs.ja: 矢倉は角道を閉じて飛車先を受け、角換わりは飛車先を受けながら角を交換する。相掛かりは角道を閉じて歩を交換し、横歩取りは角道も開く。この整理は入口であり、相手の急戦を無視して囲いを完成させる手順書ではない。後手では相手の飛車先に間に合う受けを優先する。
paragraphs.en: Yagura generally restrains both exchanges; Bishop Exchange allows bishop trades while restraining the rook pawn; Double Wing allows rook-pawn exchanges; Side Pawn Capture opens both major pieces. Use this as an orientation, not a compulsory move order. When playing second, meet immediate rook-pawn pressure before pursuing a castle, and recheck bishop drops whenever an exchange changes the position.

question.ja: 飛車先交換で得るものを三つ挙げよう。
question.en: What three benefits can a rook-pawn exchange provide?

answer.ja: 持ち歩、敵陣までの飛車の通路、２五などに攻め駒を進める空間。交換地点が守られていないことが前提。
answer.en: A pawn in hand, an open rook file and space for another attacker. First verify that the capture square is not defended.

title.ja: 矢倉囲いの組み方
title.en: Building a Yagura castle

paragraphs.ja: 矢倉は玉を８八、銀を７七、金を７八と６七に置く形が基本。カニ囲いから金銀を上げ、角を７九から６八へ退かして玉の通路を作る。上からの攻めには金銀が支え合うが、横から飛車を打たれると金の連結を狙われやすい。
paragraphs.en: A standard Yagura places the king on 88, silver on 77 and golds on 78 and 67. Develop through a Crab castle, advance the defending pieces and move the bishop out of the king’s route before entering 88. The connected golds and silver resist frontal pressure; lateral rook attacks can undermine their links and make the king’s limited escape space important.

paragraphs.ja: 駒組みの順序は相手で変える。△８五歩には７七銀を間に合わせ、角道が向かい合えば６六歩などで角交換を防ぐ。銀を先に動かして角を無防備にしない。後手で角を３三へ上げて受けた場合は、角を引く道と金の支えを確保してから銀を進める。
paragraphs.en: Adjust the order to the opponent. An advanced rook pawn requires the silver to reach 77 in time, while open opposing bishop diagonals may require 66-pawn first. Moving the silver carelessly can leave the bishop undefended. When using a bishop to stop the pawn exchange as second player, preserve its retreat route before converting to Yagura.

question.ja: △８五歩を見たら囲いの完成と７七銀のどちらを急ぐ？
question.en: After …85-pawn, which matters first: completing the castle or 77-silver?

answer.ja: ７七銀などで８六を守る。歩交換への受けを間に合わせてから囲う。
answer.en: Defend 86 with 77-silver or another sound arrangement before spending tempi on completing the castle.

title.ja: 矢倉囲いの組み方：局面の狙い
title.en: Building a Yagura castle: the plan on the board

notes.ja: ７七銀で８筋を支え、矢倉の前面を作る。
notes.en: Silver-77 supports the eighth file and forms Yagura’s front line.

notes.ja: 角を退かし、玉が８八へ進む通路を準備する。
notes.en: Retreat the bishop to prepare the king’s route toward 88.

title.ja: 矢倉棒銀の手順と組み方
title.en: Yagura Climbing Silver

paragraphs.ja: 矢倉棒銀は左の金銀三枚で玉を守り、右銀を飛車先へ送り出す。６六歩で角道を閉じるため角の打ち込みを考える局面が少なく、攻めの役割も分かりやすい。飛車・銀・歩を同じ筋に集め、相手の守り銀との交換を狙う。
paragraphs.en: Yagura Climbing Silver divides the army clearly: three left-side defenders protect the king while the right silver joins the rook-pawn attack. Closing the bishop diagonal reduces immediate bishop-trade complications. The attacking rook, silver and pawn cooperate on one file, aiming to exchange the active silver for a defending silver and open a route into the opponent’s camp.

paragraphs.ja: 銀が五段目へ届いたら、２四歩の交換後に銀で取る形を読む。銀交換で持ち駒ができれば打ち込みの選択肢が増えるが、銀を追われて戻れなくなる危険もある。棒銀の準備だけを急がず、相手の端歩、角の利き、飛車先への受けを確認して仕掛けよう。
paragraphs.en: After the silver reaches the fifth rank, calculate the pawn exchange and silver recapture rather than pushing automatically. A silver in hand gives flexible attacking drops, but an advanced silver can become trapped or lose support. Check edge-pawn responses, bishop lines and the rook’s recapture square; attacking development cannot justify leaving the Yagura defenders disconnected or the king exposed.

question.ja: 棒銀で守り銀を交換する狙いは？
question.en: Why does Climbing Silver seek a defending-silver exchange?

answer.ja: 守りを一枚減らし、飛車の道を開き、銀を持ち駒として別の急所に使うため。
answer.en: It removes a defender, opens the rook’s path and obtains a silver that can be dropped at a different weak point.

title.ja: 矢倉棒銀の手順と組み方：局面の狙い
title.en: Yagura Climbing Silver: the plan on the board

notes.ja: 玉を８八へ入れ、棒銀の進出に備える。
notes.en: Castle the king on 88 before advancing Climbing Silver.

notes.ja: ２六銀が２五の歩を支え、次の銀の進出を準備する。
notes.en: Silver-26 supports the pawn on 25 and prepares the next advance.

title.ja: 相矢倉の駒組み
title.en: Double Yagura: the 24-move foundation

paragraphs.ja: 相矢倉の24手組は、角道を閉じて５筋を突き合い、カニ囲いから矢倉の骨格へ進む見本。５筋の歩は引き角の通路を作り、６八銀は△８五歩に７七銀で受ける準備になる。24手後でも玉の入城は終わっておらず、完成図と途中図を区別しよう。
paragraphs.en: The 24-move Double Yagura foundation closes the bishop diagonal, advances the central pawns and develops through Crab castles into Yagura’s framework. The fifth-file pawn prepares a retreating bishop’s diagonal; 68-silver prepares to meet an advanced rook pawn with 77-silver. The resulting position is a development base, not a fully completed castle or a forced opening script.

paragraphs.ja: そこから３七銀で攻めを決める、角を向かい合わせる脇システム、囲いを先に進める森下システムがある。早囲いは７八金を後回しにし、角の移動を一手省く。ただし６九金が浮き、桂の急進と６五歩に弱くなるため、相手が急戦なら速度より安全を優先する。
paragraphs.en: From that base, 37-silver selects an attack, the Waki System confronts the bishops, and the Morishita System delays the attacking choice. Quick castling postpones 78-gold to save a bishop move. Its loose 69-gold and exposed diagonal give a fast knight advance and central pawn break targets, so inspect the opponent’s attacking readiness before choosing the shortcut.

question.ja: 早囲いはなぜ常に得ではない？
question.en: Why is quick Yagura castling not always better?

answer.ja: 一手省ける代わりに６九金が浮き、玉の移動中に桂跳ねと６五歩の急戦を受けやすい。
answer.en: The saved tempo comes with a loose 69-gold and vulnerability to a fast knight advance and central break while the king is moving.

title.ja: 相矢倉の駒組み：局面の狙い
title.en: Double Yagura: the 24-move foundation: the plan on the board

notes.ja: ６七金が前面を支える。まだ玉の入城は終わっていない。
notes.en: Gold-67 strengthens the front; the king has yet to complete castling.

notes.ja: ３六歩で攻め銀や桂の活用を準備する。
notes.en: Pawn-36 prepares attacking silver and knight development.

title.ja: 相矢倉での攻め方、3七銀戦法
title.en: Yagura: 37-silver and coordinated attacks

paragraphs.ja: ３七銀から３六銀・３七桂を組み、飛角銀桂で矢倉を攻める。まず３五歩の交換で持ち歩を得て角を４六へ引き、玉の入城路も開く。２筋の歩を早く２五まで突くと桂の進出先を塞ぐので、銀と桂の使い方が決まるまで保留する意味がある。
paragraphs.en: Developing the silver through 37 to 36 and the knight to 37 brings rook, bishop, silver and knight into a coordinated Yagura attack. An early third-file pawn exchange supplies a pawn in hand and lets the bishop retreat to 46, clearing the king’s route. Delaying 25-pawn preserves 25 as a future knight square rather than obstructing your own attacker.

paragraphs.ja: ２四歩への歩取りには継ぎ歩から桂を使い、銀取りには２五銀で銀交換を狙う。３三への歩打ちと端攻めを組み合わせるのが要点。ただし△６四角が出ていると単純な３五歩交換に反撃がある。３六銀を決め打ちせず、４六銀や角ぶつけへ切り替える。
paragraphs.en: Against a pawn recapture on 24, a successive pawn drop can activate the knight; against a silver recapture, 25-silver seeks an exchange. A pawn drop on 33 and edge pressure reinforce each other. If the opposing bishop has reached 64, the simple third-file exchange may allow counterplay against your silver, so choose 46-silver or a bishop confrontation instead.

question.ja: ２筋の歩を２五まで早く突かない理由は？
question.en: Why might you postpone advancing the second-file pawn to 25?

answer.ja: ３七桂から２五桂と跳ねる場所を残すため。歩で自分の桂の進路を塞がない。
answer.en: To keep 25 available for the knight from 37 rather than blocking its route with your own pawn.

title.ja: 脇システム
title.en: The Waki System

paragraphs.ja: 脇システムは相矢倉で角を６四と４六に向かい合わせる。角交換を保留して囲いと端歩を整えるのが特徴で、どちらが交換するかで銀の進出と手数が変わる。後手が早く交換すると、先手は同銀で４六へ一手で進められ、攻めの準備を助けられる。
paragraphs.en: The Waki System confronts bishops on 64 and 46 within Double Yagura. Both sides can postpone the exchange while finishing their castles and edge-pawn preparation. Who captures first matters: an early capture by the second player allows the first player’s silver to recapture on 46, effectively helping it advance and preparing a rapid-silver style attack.

paragraphs.ja: 駒組み後に先手から角交換し、銀を２六へ出して端を攻める構想もある。銀香交換でも香を重ねれば端に戦力を集中できる。ただし角交換前に銀を棒銀へ動かすと、角交換後の４七角などが厳しい。銀を進める前に交換の時機と相手の角打ちを確かめよう。
paragraphs.en: Another plan is to exchange bishops after development, shift the silver to 26 and attack the edge. A silver-for-lance trade can be justified by stacking lances on the opened file. Moving the silver into Climbing Silver before resolving the bishop confrontation gives the opponent dangerous bishop-drop squares, including 47. Calculate the exchange order and drops before committing the silver.

question.ja: 角が向かい合った直後に後手から交換すると、先手の何が進む？
question.en: What does an immediate bishop exchange by the second player help develop?

answer.ja: 先手の銀が同銀で４六へ進む。交換の手順が攻め銀の進出を助ける。
answer.en: The first player’s silver recaptures on 46, so the exchange helps develop the attacking silver.

title.ja: 脇システム：局面の狙い
title.en: The Waki System: the plan on the board

notes.ja: ６四角は、これから４六へ出る先手角と向かい合う。
notes.en: Bishop-64 prepares the confrontation with Black’s bishop on 46.

notes.ja: 両角を向かい合わせ、交換の時機を争う。
notes.en: The bishops confront one another; the timing of the exchange now matters.

title.ja: 雀刺し
title.en: Sparrow Spearing

paragraphs.ja: 雀刺しは相手玉が矢倉の２二へ入ったところを端から攻める。１七香の後ろへ１八飛を回し、６八角の斜線も１三へ通す。端歩を突き合っていれば２六銀を加え、１五歩・同歩・同銀で香との交換を狙う。駒損だけでなく突破後の大駒の働きを評価する。
paragraphs.en: Sparrow Spearing concentrates force on the edge beside a Yagura king. Advance the lance to 17, place the rook behind it on 18 and use the bishop’s diagonal toward 13. With mutually advanced edge pawns, a silver on 26 supports 15-pawn and the silver recapture. A silver-for-lance trade is judged by the opened edge and major-piece activity, not material alone.

paragraphs.ja: 端の位を取れた形では銀より桂を使い、２五桂から１三への成り捨てを考える。そのため２五へ歩を置かず、桂の進出先を残す。相手の銀が端へ取るか２四へ逃げるかで追撃は変わる。飛車・角・香の利きが揃う前に桂だけ捨てても攻めは続かない。
paragraphs.en: When you own the edge space, the knight can attack through 25 and sacrifice on 13 instead. Keep your second-file pawn back so it does not occupy the knight’s square. The continuation changes according to whether the defending silver captures on the edge or retreats toward 24. Sacrifice only after the rook, bishop and lance can exploit the resulting opening.

question.ja: 端歩を受けられた形と、端の位を取った形で主に使う攻め駒は？
question.en: Which attacker changes between mutually advanced edge pawns and an edge-space advantage?

answer.ja: 端歩を突き合う形は銀、位を取る形は桂を中心にする。どちらも飛角香の支援が必要。
answer.en: Use the silver in the mutually advanced-pawn plan and the knight in the edge-space plan, supported by rook, bishop and lance.

title.ja: 雀刺し：局面の狙い
title.en: Sparrow Spearing: the plan on the board

notes.ja: 飛車を１筋へ回し、香と銀と協力して端を攻める。
notes.en: Swing the rook to the first file to attack with lance and silver.

notes.ja: 銀で端歩を取り、銀香交換を含む端の突破を狙う。
notes.en: Capture the edge pawn with the silver, aiming at a breakthrough that may involve trading silver for lance.

title.ja: 矢倉戦法vs一直線棒銀
title.en: Yagura against a direct Climbing Silver

paragraphs.ja: 玉を囲わず棒銀を急ぐ相手には、矢倉完成より争点の守備を先にする。７九角から６八角へ引くと８六への利きを補強できる。相手の銀が９五へ出ても端歩で追うだけでは８六歩から銀交換を許し、相手に銀と歩の持ち駒を与える。
paragraphs.en: Against an opponent who rushes Climbing Silver without castling, defend the contact square before finishing Yagura. Retreating the bishop through 79 toward 68 reinforces 86. Trying only to chase a silver on 95 with an edge pawn can allow the eighth-file exchange anyway, giving the attacker flexible silver and pawn drops while your castle is still incomplete.

paragraphs.ja: ７筋も突いてくるなら４六角で飛車の斜めを狙い、守りに手数を使わせる。相手が角を引いて８六の利きを足す場合は８八銀へ引いて菊水矢倉を考える。６筋の突き捨てで角道を開く攻めには、５五歩で角を誘い５八飛で対抗する。受けは攻めの形ごとに変える。
paragraphs.en: If the attacker opens the seventh file, 46-bishop can pressure the rook diagonally and force defensive moves. A retreating enemy bishop adds support to 86, making an 88-silver retreat and Kikusui formation relevant. A sixth-file sacrifice opens a different bishop line; a central pawn offer and rook shift can oppose it. Count attackers anew whenever the opponent changes the bishop’s role.

question.ja: 相手が引き角で８六を補強したら、同じ交換の受けを続けてよい？
question.en: Can you repeat the same exchange defense after the opponent adds a retreating bishop?

answer.ja: 利きの枚数が変わる。銀を引くなど、交換を避ける形に組み替える必要がある。
answer.en: No. The number of attackers has changed; consider retreating the silver and changing formation instead of relying on the old exchange calculation.

title.ja: 矢倉戦法vs一直線棒銀：局面の狙い
title.en: Yagura against a direct Climbing Silver: the plan on the board

notes.ja: 角を７九へ引き、銀の攻撃を避ける準備をする。
notes.en: Retreat the bishop to 79 before the attacking silver approaches.

notes.ja: 角を６八へ移し、棒銀の狙う８筋から外す。
notes.en: Move the bishop to 68, away from Climbing Silver’s eighth-file target.

title.ja: 矢倉戦法vs右四間飛車
title.en: Yagura against Right Fourth-file Rook

paragraphs.ja: 右四間飛車は角道を止めた６筋へ飛車・銀・桂を集め、△６五歩を争点にする。７八金で角を支え、右銀を４八から５七へ使って６六を補強する。金だけ先に上げて銀を浮かせると角交換後の両取りが生じるため、囲いの手順にも意味がある。
paragraphs.en: Right Fourth-file Rook targets the sixth-file pawn that closes Yagura’s bishop diagonal. Support the bishop with 78-gold and develop the right silver through 48 toward 57 to reinforce the contact square. Advancing only the gold can leave a loose silver vulnerable to a bishop-drop fork after an exchange. Development order therefore protects pieces as well as constructing the castle.

paragraphs.ja: ７七へ銀や角を置くと△８五桂の標的になりやすい。角を８八に残し、玉を７九へ移して角交換を玉で取り返せる形なら、壁金を避けられる。早い６五歩には銀で利きを足す受けがあり、銀を追われた際の５五への逃げで角筋を遮る。完成形を急いで押しつけない。
paragraphs.en: A piece on 77 can become the target of an 85-knight advance. Leaving the bishop on 88 and moving the king toward 79 can allow a king recapture, avoiding an obstructive gold on 88. Against an early break, adding the silver’s support and later escaping toward 55 can obstruct the bishop line. Choose the defense for the actual attack timing.

question.ja: 対右四間で７七に駒を置かない構想の狙いは？
question.en: Why may the defender deliberately leave 77 empty against Right Fourth-file Rook?

answer.ja: △８五桂の当たりを減らし、８八角で６六を守るため。
answer.en: It reduces targets for …85-knight while the bishop on 88 continues to support 66.

title.ja: 矢倉戦法vs右四間飛車：局面の狙い
title.en: Yagura against Right Fourth-file Rook: the plan on the board

notes.ja: ６筋へ飛車を回し、腰掛け銀と歩で６六を狙う。
notes.en: The rook switches to the sixth file, coordinating with silver and pawn against 66.

notes.ja: ６七金で６六を支え、中央への集中攻撃に備える。
notes.en: Gold-67 supports 66 against the concentrated central attack.

title.ja: 矢倉戦法vs居角左美濃急戦
title.en: A rapid Left Mino with an unmoved bishop

paragraphs.ja: 居角左美濃は角を８八に残し、玉を６八から７九へ、左銀を７八へ置いて短い手数で守る。右銀４七と桂３七で攻めを用意する。相手の矢倉が完成する前に４五歩と３五歩を捨て、４五桂から仕掛ける速度が武器で、飛車先の交換を許す手もある。
paragraphs.en: The unmoved-bishop Left Mino uses a bishop on 88, silver on 78 and king developed through 68 toward 79 to castle quickly. A right silver on 47 and knight on 37 prepare the attack. Sacrificing fourth- and third-file pawns opens a 45-knight jump before the opponent finishes Yagura; allowing a rook-pawn exchange can be a deliberate trade of space for time.

paragraphs.ja: 飛車を２四へ進めた後、４四へ切って金や角を呼び、３三歩の叩きで守りの連結を崩す筋がある。左美濃の横からの強さが飛車交換後の攻め合いを支えるが、形が違えば飛車切りは成立しない。相手が横歩を取れば６六角で飛車の帰路を狭め、銀も追撃へ加える。
paragraphs.en: A rook on 24 can sometimes sacrifice on 44, drawing out a gold or bishop so a 33-pawn drop breaks the defenders’ coordination. Left Mino’s lateral defense supports the resulting race, but the sacrifice depends on the exact pieces and tempi. If the opponent takes a side pawn instead, developing the bishop to 66 restricts the rook’s return route and allows silver pressure.

question.ja: 飛車を切る前の３五歩の突き捨ては何を用意する？
question.en: What does the third-file pawn sacrifice prepare before the rook sacrifice?

answer.ja: 持ち歩を使う３三歩の叩きと、３筋を絡めた守りの分断。
answer.en: A pawn drop on 33 and a third-file attack that separates the opponent’s defenders.

title.ja: 矢倉戦法vs居角左美濃急戦：局面の狙い
title.en: A rapid Left Mino with an unmoved bishop: the plan on the board

notes.ja: 歩の突き捨てで空けた４五へ桂を使う。
notes.en: Jump the knight to 45 after the pawn sacrifices clear its route.

notes.ja: 飛車を４四へ切り込ませ、金の連結を狙う。応手まで確認して評価する。
notes.en: Bring the rook into 44 to attack the gold structure; evaluate the sacrifice together with the reply.

title.ja: 雁木囲いの組み方
title.en: Building a Gangi formation

paragraphs.ja: 雁木の共通点は左銀を６七に置くこと。右銀４七のツノ銀、右銀５七の旧型、玉を右へ置く右玉などがある。金銀を互いに支える位置へ並べるため、矢倉ほど一点に堅くはないが、攻めの方向を変えやすく角打ちの隙も抑えやすい。
paragraphs.en: Gangi’s common feature is the left silver on 67. Horned-Silver Gangi places the other silver on 47; the older two-silver version uses 57, while Right King changes the king’s position. Its staggered defenders emphasize balance rather than Yagura’s concentrated hardness, offering flexible attacking choices and reducing loose squares for bishop drops when the pieces remain properly connected.

paragraphs.ja: 角道を６六歩で閉じ、飛車先は７七角で受ける形から組める。横歩取りや角換わりの出だしからも合流するが、角交換後に同じ順をそのまま使うものではない。５筋を開けた引き角、４五歩の仕掛け、右四間への転換を選ぶ。囲いだけ完成させても攻めの計画は別に必要。
paragraphs.en: A closed diagonal and a bishop on 77 can stop the opposing rook pawn while the left silver develops to 67. Several opening approaches can transpose into this formation, but bishop exchanges change the move-order requirements. Choose a retreating-bishop plan, a fourth-file break or Right Fourth-file Rook coordination; completing the shell alone does not activate the attackers.

question.ja: ツノ銀雁木と旧型二枚銀雁木の右銀の違いは？
question.en: Where does the right silver differ between Horned-Silver and older two-silver Gangi?

answer.ja: ツノ銀は４七、旧型は５七。左銀６七は共通する。
answer.en: Horned-Silver uses 47; the older form uses 57. Both share the left silver on 67.

title.ja: 雁木囲いの組み方：局面の狙い
title.en: Building a Gangi formation: the plan on the board

notes.ja: ６七銀が角頭と中央を支える雁木の柱になる。
notes.en: Silver-67 supports the bishop’s head and center as a pillar of Gangi.

notes.ja: 銀を４七へ置き、二枚銀で中央に備える。
notes.en: Silver-47 completes a two-silver defense of the center.

title.ja: ツノ銀雁木の手順と組み方
title.en: Attacking from Horned-Silver Gangi

paragraphs.ja: ツノ銀雁木の攻めは３七桂と４五歩が軸。５六歩で角の通路を作り６八角へ引けば、４五歩・同歩・同桂で銀を追い、２四歩から角交換を狙える。角交換後に飛車を２九まで引くのは、持ち角で飛車を狙われる隙を減らすため。
paragraphs.en: Horned-Silver Gangi attacks often revolve around the knight on 37 and a fourth-file break. Advancing the fifth-file pawn clears a retreating bishop’s route to 68. After 45-pawn, the knight can recapture and threaten a silver; a second-file pawn exchange can then enable a bishop trade. Retreating the rook to 29 afterward reduces bishop-drop attacks against it.

paragraphs.ja: 別の構想は６五歩で角道を開けて複数の歩を捨て、角切りから飛車の両取りを狙うもの。銀を５六へ出して飛車を４筋へ回れば右四間にもなる。雁木は角打ちには比較的強いが飛車打ちには注意が必要で、同じ攻めでも大駒を何と交換するかが重要になる。
paragraphs.en: Alternatively, reopen the bishop diagonal and sacrifice several pawns to prepare a bishop sacrifice and rook fork. A silver on 56 with the rook shifted to the fourth file gives a Right Fourth-file Rook plan. These attacks exploit different defenders. Gangi’s relative resistance to bishop drops does not make rook drops harmless, so distinguish the consequences of trading a bishop from sacrificing the rook.

question.ja: 角交換後に飛車を２九まで引く理由は？
question.en: Why retreat the rook all the way to 29 after a bishop exchange?

answer.ja: 相手の角打ちで飛車を狙われる隙を減らし、角に強い雁木の陣形を保つため。
answer.en: To reduce bishop-drop targets against the rook while retaining Gangi’s connected formation.

title.ja: ツノ銀雁木の手順と組み方：局面の狙い
title.en: Attacking from Horned-Silver Gangi: the plan on the board

notes.ja: 桂を３七へ使い、右銀と攻めを組み合わせる。
notes.en: Develop Knight-37 to coordinate the attack with the right silver.

notes.ja: 角を６八へ引き、飛車先と中央への活用を準備する。
notes.en: Retreat Bishop-68 to prepare activity toward the rook file and center.

title.ja: 角換わりの基本、最初の駒組み
title.en: Bishop Exchange: the starting formation

paragraphs.ja: 角換わりでは７七角で飛車先を受け、８八銀を添えて角交換を同銀で取れる形にする。７七銀が８六を守るので、角を持ち駒にしても飛車先への受けが残る。その後は金をつなぎ、攻め銀を棒銀・早繰り銀・腰掛け銀のどれに使うか決める。
paragraphs.en: In Bishop Exchange, the bishop on 77 initially stops the rook pawn and 88-silver prepares a silver recapture when bishops trade. The resulting silver on 77 continues to defend 86 even though the bishop is now in hand. Connect the golds and choose how to use the attacking silver: Climbing Silver, Rapid Silver or Reclining Silver each creates different contact points.

paragraphs.ja: 角が手持ちになった直後に飛車先交換だけを急ぐと、３五角から５七への成り込みなどを許す。玉を動かし、角打ちの隙を消してから攻める。相手が角交換を拒否すれば飛車先を伸ばして角を受けに使わせ、引き角から交換を狙う余地もある。交換できない形なら無理に強行しない。
paragraphs.en: An immediate rook-pawn exchange can permit a bishop drop on 35 followed by promotion toward 57. Move the king and inspect drop threats before attacking. If the opponent closes the diagonal, advancing the rook pawn may force their bishop to defend, after which a retreating bishop can seek a later exchange. Do not force that exchange after the defending silver has arrived.

question.ja: ８八銀を角交換の前に指す目的は？
question.en: Why prepare 88-silver before the bishop exchange?

answer.ja: ７七で銀が取り返し、その銀で８六を守れるようにするため。
answer.en: To recapture on 77 with the silver, which then protects 86 against the opposing rook pawn.

title.ja: 角換わりの基本、最初の駒組み：局面の狙い
title.en: Bishop Exchange: the starting formation: the plan on the board

notes.ja: 角を交換し、双方の角打ちが常に問題になる。
notes.en: Exchange bishops; bishop drops become a continuing concern for both players.

notes.ja: 銀で取り返し、７七銀で飛車先を守る。
notes.en: Recapture with the silver, defending the rook file from 77.

title.ja: 角換わり棒銀
title.en: Bishop Exchange Climbing Silver

paragraphs.ja: 角換わり棒銀は右銀を３八・２七・２六へ送り、２筋と端を狙う。相手が１四歩で銀の進出を止めれば、１六歩から１五歩の交換で銀香交換を考える。取った香を飛車へ打つ筋と、６六角で銀や桂を狙う筋が結びつくため、交換後の持ち駒が重要。
paragraphs.en: Bishop Exchange Climbing Silver develops the right silver through 38, 27 and 26 to attack the rook file or edge. If 14-pawn prevents the silver’s advance, an edge-pawn exchange can lead to a silver-for-lance trade. The acquired lance can attack the rook while a bishop drop on 66 pressures defenders; calculate the resulting drops before evaluating the material exchange.

paragraphs.ja: 端攻めの反撃には１六への歩打ちから角の侵入があり、１八歩で成り込みを止める受けを知ろう。また△５四角は２七への歩打ちと２四の銀取りを狙う。３八角で２七を支える升田新手はその対策。銀交換だけを目標にせず、飛車の逃げ場所と自玉の安全も確認する。
paragraphs.en: Edge counterplay includes a pawn drop on 16 and bishop invasion, so a defensive pawn on 18 can matter. A bishop on 54 also prepares a pawn drop on 27 that separates the rook from its advanced silver. The Masuda bishop drop on 38 supports 27. Before forcing exchanges, move the king out of immediate forks and preserve a usable rook retreat.

question.ja: △５四角に対する３八角はどこを補強する？
question.en: Which square does the Masuda bishop drop on 38 reinforce against …54-bishop?

answer.ja: ２七。歩打ちで飛車と攻め銀を分断する反撃に対応する。
answer.en: 27, countering the pawn drop that tries to separate the rook from its attacking silver.

title.ja: 角換わり早繰り銀
title.en: Bishop Exchange Rapid Silver

paragraphs.ja: 早繰り銀は３六歩から銀を３七・４六へ進め、３五歩の交換で五段目へ出る。△３四歩で追われても２四歩で銀交換を狙う構想がある。棒銀と似た突破を狙いながら、３筋を空けるので角打ちの隙が増える。仕掛ける前に玉を６八などへ動かす。
paragraphs.en: Rapid Silver advances through 37 to 46 after developing the third-file pawn. A pawn exchange on 35 brings the silver to the fifth rank, where a second-file break can still threaten an exchange even if a pawn drop tries to chase it. Opening the third file also exposes bishop-drop diagonals, so move the king before committing to the attack.

paragraphs.ja: 居玉で銀交換から２四飛と進むと１五角の王手飛車がある。端歩１六もその筋を消す手になる。相手の８六歩・同歩・８五歩には、もう一度取ると８五飛が銀桂両取りになる場合がある。３四歩と攻め合い、後の８八歩で飛車の侵入を抑える受けも読む。
paragraphs.en: Leaving the king at home can allow a bishop drop on 15 to fork king and rook after the silver exchange. An edge pawn on 16 also covers that drop. Watch the opponent’s successive eighth-file pawn offers: a second capture may allow an 85-rook fork against silver and knight. Consider continuing your own attack while reserving a pawn block against the rook.

question.ja: 銀交換ができても居玉のままなら何を警戒する？
question.en: What must you check even after achieving the intended silver exchange?

answer.ja: １五角などの王手飛車。銀交換の成功だけで攻めが成立したとは言えない。
answer.en: Bishop drops that fork king and rook, especially 15-bishop. The silver exchange alone does not prove the attack works.

title.ja: 角換わり腰掛け銀　木村定跡
title.en: Reclining Silver: the Kimura joseki

paragraphs.ja: 木村定跡は先後同型の角換わり腰掛け銀で、先手が複数の争点を順番に作る教材。４五歩で桂の進路を開き、３五歩で３筋の歩打ちを準備する。７五歩の突き捨ては相手の桂頭を弱め、２筋の歩交換はその弱点を狙う持ち歩を得る。全盤を見る攻めの組み立てが要点。
paragraphs.en: The Kimura joseki studies a particular symmetrical Reclining Silver position, not an automatic win for every Bishop Exchange game. The attacker creates successive targets: 45-pawn opens a knight route, 35-pawn prepares third-file pressure, and a seventh-file pawn sacrifice weakens the opposing knight’s head. The second-file exchange then supplies a pawn in hand to exploit that weakness.

paragraphs.ja: △６三角などで中央と桂頭を同時に守られたら端へ転じる。１五歩・同歩・１三歩で香を吊り上げ、２五桂が端と３筋を両方狙う。桂で３三へ成ると飛車道が通り、最後の１一角は玉を送り、攻めをつなぐ。駒配置が異なる実戦では同じ順を暗記して強行しない。
paragraphs.en: A defensive bishop on 63 covers both central and knight-head threats, so the attack turns to the edge. Offering an edge pawn and dropping on 13 draws the lance forward; 25-knight then attacks both the edge and third file. A knight promotion on 33 opens the rook route, and a bishop drop on 11 displaces the king. Check every prerequisite before applying this pattern.

question.ja: ２筋の歩交換は飛車の活用以外に何を用意する？
question.en: What does the second-file pawn exchange prepare besides rook activity?

answer.ja: 持ち歩を得て７四歩の桂頭攻めや１三歩の端攻めを可能にする。
answer.en: It supplies a pawn for a knight-head attack on 74 or an edge drop on 13.

title.ja: 角換わり腰掛け銀　木村定跡：局面の狙い
title.en: Reclining Silver: the Kimura joseki: the plan on the board

notes.ja: 角を77へ進める。成って働きを強める。
notes.en: Move the bishop to 77 and promote.

notes.ja: ６三角で中央と桂頭を守られたため、端への攻めを比較する。
notes.en: Bishop*63 defends the center and knight’s head; compare an edge attack.

notes.ja: 桂を33へ進める。成って働きを強める。
notes.en: Move the knight to 33 and promote.

notes.ja: １一角で玉の位置を変え、飛車による攻めにつなぐ。
notes.en: Bishop*11 displaces the king and helps continue the rook attack.

title.ja: 角換わり▲4五桂急戦
title.en: Bishop Exchange: the 45-knight rapid attack

paragraphs.ja: ４五桂急戦は囲いを最小限にし、３六歩・４六歩・２五歩と玉の移動で桂の進出を準備する。４六歩は４五桂を支える。相手が４五を銀などで十分に守れば強行できない。４五桂は３三銀を狙うと同時に５三桂不成の侵入を見せ、相手の受け方を限定する。
paragraphs.en: The 45-knight rapid attack uses minimal development: third- and fourth-file pawns prepare the knight, the rook pawn advances, and the king moves out of immediate danger. The pawn on 46 supports the knight on 45. Do not force the jump against adequate control of 45. Its dual purpose is to attack the silver on 33 and threaten an unpromoted intrusion on 53.

paragraphs.ja: △４四銀には２筋の歩を交換して３四飛と横歩を取り、飛車切りの可能性を読む。△４二銀には６六角で攻めを補強し、３三桂には交換して４五へ打ち直す筋がある。攻めは手数が勝負で、形の小さな違いが成否を分ける。飛車を渡した後の反撃も必ず比較する。
paragraphs.en: If the silver advances to 44, exchange the rook pawn and consider a side-pawn capture on 34 with rook-sacrifice threats. A retreat to 42 invites a bishop drop on 66; a defensive knight on 33 can sometimes be exchanged and redropped on 45. These continuations depend on precise tempi and defending pieces, including the counterattack after a rook sacrifice.

question.ja: ４六歩を入れてから４五桂と跳ねる意味は？
question.en: Why advance 46-pawn before jumping the knight to 45?

answer.ja: 桂を歩で支えるため。ただし４五の相手の利きが多ければ、それだけでは仕掛けられない。
answer.en: The pawn supports the knight. That support does not make the attack valid if the opponent already controls 45 sufficiently.

title.ja: 角換わり▲4五桂急戦：局面の狙い
title.en: Bishop Exchange: the 45-knight rapid attack: the plan on the board

notes.ja: 角を77へ進める。成って働きを強める。
notes.en: Move the bishop to 77 and promote.

notes.ja: ４五桂は玉を囲い切る前の速攻。３三銀に当てる。
notes.en: Knight-45 launches the early attack before full castling and attacks Silver-33.

notes.ja: 飛車切り後に桂で５三へ入り、中央の弱点を狙う。
notes.en: After sacrificing the rook, enter 53 with the knight to attack the central weakness.

title.ja: 角換わり腰掛け銀　▲4八金▲2九飛型
title.en: Reclining Silver: 48-gold and 29-rook

paragraphs.ja: ４八金・２九飛型は桂を３七へ先に跳ね、右銀を４七から５六へ使う。飛車を一段引き金を４八へ置くことで、持ち角に狙われる自陣の隙を減らす。腰掛け銀の４五歩の仕掛けでも、銀より桂を先に使って相手の守り銀を動かす構想になる。
paragraphs.en: The 48-gold, 29-rook formation develops the knight early to 37 and the right silver through 47 toward 56. Retreating the rook one rank and positioning the gold on 48 reduces bishop-drop targets inside your camp. After the fourth-file pawn break, use the knight before the silver to displace the defending silver and preserve your central coordination.

paragraphs.ja: 桂が４五へ出て△４四銀とされれば、４六への歩打ちで支える。銀が２二へ下がれば４四へ歩を打ち、相手の桂取りの歩を防ぐ。桂を銀で取られた場合は同銀で五段目へ出て３筋を絡める。堅い形でも攻め銀が動いた後の角打ちは改めて確認する。
paragraphs.en: Against a silver on 44, a pawn drop on 46 supports the knight. If the silver retreats to 22, a pawn on 44 occupies the square the opponent wants for a knight-chasing pawn. If the knight is captured by a silver, recapture and involve the third file. Reassess bishop drops after your silver moves; the original formation’s safety is not permanent.

question.ja: ４五桂に△４四銀とされたとき、どこへ歩を打って支える？
question.en: Where can a pawn drop support the knight after 45-knight and …44-silver?

answer.ja: ４六。歩が４五へ利いて桂を支える。２六ではない。
answer.en: 46, where the pawn supports 45. A pawn on 26 would not support that knight.

title.ja: 角換わり腰掛け銀　▲4八金▲2九飛型：局面の狙い
title.en: Reclining Silver: 48-gold and 29-rook: the plan on the board

notes.ja: 角を77へ進める。成って働きを強める。
notes.en: Move the bishop to 77 and promote.

notes.ja: ４八金と２九飛で攻めの反動に備える。
notes.en: Gold-48 and Rook-29 prepare for counterplay against the attack.

notes.ja: ４六へ歩を打ち、進出した桂を支える。
notes.en: Drop a pawn on 46 to support the advanced knight.

title.ja: 一手損角換わり
title.en: One-tempo-loss Bishop Exchange

paragraphs.ja: 一手損角換わりは後手が先手の角が８八にいるうちに交換する。通常の角換わりでは先手の７七角に一手使わせてから交換するため手数が釣り合うが、早い交換では先手の銀の進出を助けて後手が一手失う。駒の損ではなく、駒組みの速度の差を指す言葉。
paragraphs.en: One-tempo-loss Bishop Exchange has the second player trade bishops before the first player moves the bishop from 88. In ordinary Bishop Exchange, the first player spends a tempo developing the bishop to 77 before the trade. Trading earlier helps the recapturing silver develop without that prior bishop move. The “loss” concerns development time, not a material deficit.

paragraphs.ja: 後手はその代わり８五歩を保留して、将来７三桂から８五桂と跳ねる場所を残す。歩を早く進めるか桂の空間を残すかが実戦的な違い。手損したから必敗という意味ではないが、先手の早い銀攻めには正確な対応が要る。交換後も角打ちの隙を消しながら金銀をつなぐ。
paragraphs.en: The second player commonly postpones 85-pawn, preserving 85 for a future knight jump from 73. That flexibility distinguishes the strategy from simply copying ordinary Bishop Exchange a move late. The tempo concession does not mean a forced loss, but fast silver attacks require care. After the trade, connect the defenders and inspect bishop-drop targets before deciding when to advance the rook pawn.

question.ja: ８五歩を保留する具体的な狙いは？
question.en: What concrete option does postponing …85-pawn preserve?

answer.ja: ７三桂から８五桂と跳ねる場所を残す。自分の歩で桂の進路を塞がない。
answer.en: It leaves 85 available for the knight from 73 instead of occupying it with your own pawn.

title.ja: 一手損角換わり：局面の狙い
title.en: One-tempo-loss Bishop Exchange: the plan on the board

notes.ja: 飛車先を保留して角交換するのが一手損角換わりの出だし。
notes.en: Exchange bishops before advancing the rook pawn: the distinguishing move order of one-tempo-loss Bishop Exchange.

notes.ja: ８四で歩を止め、後の桂や銀の使い方に余地を残す。
notes.en: Keep the rook pawn on 84, preserving options for knight and silver development.

title.ja: 相掛かりの基本、最初の駒組み
title.en: Double Wing Attack: basic development

paragraphs.ja: 相掛かりは角道を開けずに双方が飛車先を伸ばす。７八金と３二金で８七・２三を守ってから歩を交換するのが基本。交換後は２八飛で引き飛車にするか、２六飛で浮き飛車にするかを選ぶ。浮き飛車は横の守備と移動に利点があるが、自陣の守り方も変わる。
paragraphs.en: Double Wing Attack begins with rook-pawn advances while the bishop diagonals remain closed. Develop 78-gold and 32-gold to defend 87 and 23 before exchanging the pawns. The first player then chooses a deep rook retreat to 28 or a floating rook on 26. The floating rook supports lateral defense and transfers, but changes how the home camp is protected.

paragraphs.ja: 金上がりを省くと、先に攻めた側が有利とは限らない。相手の歩の取り込みや８七への歩打ちで角を取られ、持ち角の反撃が先に来る。歩交換後の持ち歩は守りにも必要なので、全部を攻めへ使わない。相手の飛車の横利きがある間は銀だけで強行突破しない。
paragraphs.en: Skipping the gold move can let the opponent push through toward the bishop or drop a pawn behind your advanced pawn. A captured bishop then creates immediate counterplay before your attack matures. Reserve exchanged pawns for defensive drops as well as threats, and avoid forcing a silver attack while the opposing floating rook still controls the contact rank.

question.ja: 相掛かりで歩交換前に７八金を指す役割は？
question.en: What does 78-gold accomplish before a Double Wing pawn exchange?

answer.ja: ８七を守り、相手の飛車先から角を狙う攻めを抑える。
answer.en: It defends 87 and restrains the opposing rook-pawn attack toward your bishop.

title.ja: 相掛かりの基本、最初の駒組み：局面の狙い
title.en: Double Wing Attack: basic development: the plan on the board

notes.ja: 飛車先の歩を交換して持ち歩を得る。
notes.en: Exchange the rook pawn to obtain a pawn in hand.

notes.ja: 飛車を引いて相掛かりの駒組みへ進む。
notes.en: Retreat the rook and continue Double Wing Attack development.

title.ja: 相掛かり棒銀（UFO銀）
title.en: Double Wing Climbing Silver: UFO Silver

paragraphs.ja: 相掛かり棒銀は飛車を２八へ引き、銀を３八・２七・３六とジグザグに進めるUFO銀が特徴。２五銀まで出れば２四への歩打ちで突破を狙える。歩交換で２筋の歩が手持ちになっているので、駒組み中の歩打ちと二歩の条件を混同しない。
paragraphs.en: Double Wing Climbing Silver uses a deep rook on 28 and a zigzag silver route through 38, 27 and 36, known as UFO Silver. Reaching 25 enables a pawn drop on 24 to begin the breakthrough. Because the original rook pawn was exchanged, the attack uses a pawn from hand; confirm both the available pawn and the absence of another unpromoted pawn on that file.

paragraphs.ja: 相手が３三角と上がり、３五歩で角道を通すと、浮き飛車の横利きも２四へ届く。銀・角・飛車の交換を数えると攻め駒が足りなくなるため、強行せず玉を６八へ、金を５八へ整える。いちご囲いなどで待ち、相手の横利きが止まる機会や攻めへの反撃を狙う。
paragraphs.en: The defense develops 33-bishop and may advance 35-pawn, bringing both bishop and floating rook onto the exchange square. Count the full capture sequence: your silver and rook may be insufficient. Instead, develop the king toward 68 and gold to 58, forming a Strawberry-style defense. Wait for the opposing rook’s lateral control to disappear or counterattack when the opponent commits.

question.ja: ３三角と浮き飛車に対して２四の攻めを強行する前に何を数える？
question.en: What should you count before forcing the 24 attack against a bishop and floating rook?

answer.ja: ２四へ利く攻め駒と守り駒、交換後に飛車を取り返せる駒。
answer.en: Every attacker and defender on 24, including the rook’s lateral recapture after the bishop exchange.

title.ja: 相掛かり棒銀（UFO銀）：局面の狙い
title.en: Double Wing Climbing Silver: UFO Silver: the plan on the board

notes.ja: 銀を２七へ上げ、交換済みの飛車先を利用する。
notes.en: Develop Silver-27 using the space created by the rook-pawn exchange.

notes.ja: 銀を３六へ浮かせ、横から飛車先を支えるUFO銀の形。
notes.en: Silver-36 supports the rook file from the side, forming UFO Silver.

title.ja: 相掛かり ひねり飛車
title.en: Twisting Rook from Double Wing Attack

paragraphs.ja: ひねり飛車は相掛かりの浮き飛車を左へ転じ、石田流の形へ組み替える。３八銀は居飛車なら攻め、振り直せば美濃の守りに使える位置。３六飛で３四歩を狙う縦歩取りは、相手に３三金などを指させて陣形を制限する役割もある。
paragraphs.en: Twisting Rook starts as Double Wing Attack, then transfers a floating rook left into an Ishida-style formation. A silver on 38 remains useful: it can attack in Static Rook or defend a later Mino castle. Moving the rook to 36 threatens the third-file pawn vertically, sometimes inducing 33-gold and restricting the opponent’s bishop and king-side coordination.

paragraphs.ja: 端歩と角道を整え、７五歩で位を取り、７七桂を跳ねて７六飛へ回る。相手の棒銀には桂で銀の進出を抑え、９七角と７五歩で追い返す組み方もある。最後は右へ玉を囲うが、２筋の歩がないため通常の美濃より玉頭に注意。飛車を動かす前に横利きが通るか確認する。
paragraphs.en: After preparing the edge and bishop diagonal, take seventh-file space, develop 77-knight and move the rook to 76. Against Climbing Silver, the knight can obstruct the silver before 97-bishop and 75-pawn chase it back. Castle on the right afterward, remembering that the exchanged second-file pawn leaves the king’s head thinner than an ordinary Mino. Confirm the rook’s lateral path is clear.

question.ja: ３八銀を先に置くと、戦法を変えた後どんな役割になる？
question.en: What role can the 38-silver take after the rook changes wings?

answer.ja: 右へ囲う美濃の守り銀になる。居飛車のままなら攻め銀にも使える。
answer.en: It becomes a defending silver for the right-side Mino; if the rook stays static, it can still join the attack.

title.ja: 相掛かり ひねり飛車：局面の狙い
title.en: Twisting Rook from Double Wing Attack: the plan on the board

notes.ja: ７五歩で飛車を７六へ振り直す空間を作る。
notes.en: Pawn-75 creates space for the rook to switch to 76.

notes.ja: 飛車を左へひねり、７筋の歩と桂を活用する。
notes.en: Twist the rook leftward to use the seventh-file pawn and knight.

title.ja: 横歩取りの基本、最初の駒組み
title.en: Side Pawn Capture: the starting position

paragraphs.ja: 横歩取りは双方が角道を開け、飛車先の歩を交換した後、先手が３四飛と横歩を取る形。７八金と３二金で飛車先を支えてから交換する。先手は一歩得するが、飛車が前線へ出て玉の囲いも未完成なので、駒得だけを見て安全な形と思わない。
paragraphs.en: Side Pawn Capture opens both bishop diagonals before the rook-pawn exchanges, then the first player takes the third-file pawn with the rook. The golds on 78 and 32 support the exposed rook files. Taking the side pawn earns material, but the rook is advanced and neither king is fully sheltered. Treat initiative, rook escape squares and bishop tactics as seriously as the extra pawn.

paragraphs.ja: 後手の３三角、３三桂、角交換で戦型が分かれる。金を省いて歩交換すると角交換後の３三角の両取りがあり、２筋の垂れ歩も残る。また角を残して後手も横歩を取ると、先手の角交換と飛車成りが厳しい。相横歩取りは角交換など必要な準備をした別の形。
paragraphs.en: The next branch depends on 33-bishop, 33-knight or a bishop exchange. Skipping the gold move can permit a bishop-drop fork and a hanging pawn on the second file. The second player cannot simply take the opposite side pawn while leaving the bishops unchanged: a bishop trade can expose a gold or silver to rook promotion. Double Side Pawn Capture requires its own preparation.

question.ja: 後手もすぐ７六飛と横歩を取れば、単純に互角になる？
question.en: Does an immediate …76-rook side-pawn capture automatically restore equality?

answer.ja: 角を残したままでは角交換から金銀を狙う飛車成りがある。必要な準備を読まずに取らない。
answer.en: No. With the bishops unchanged, a bishop trade can expose defenders to rook promotion; calculate the preparation first.

title.ja: 横歩取りの基本、最初の駒組み：局面の狙い
title.en: Side Pawn Capture: the starting position: the plan on the board

notes.ja: 後手も飛車先を交換し、互いの飛車が前線へ出る。
notes.en: White also exchanges the rook pawn; both rooks enter the front line.

notes.ja: ３四の横歩を取る。角筋と飛車の退路も確認する。
notes.en: Capture the side pawn on 34; inspect the bishop diagonal and the rook’s retreat route.

title.ja: 横歩取り△2三歩戦法
title.en: Side Pawn Capture with an early 23-pawn

paragraphs.ja: 後手が飛車先交換を迫らず２三歩と打てば、先手は３四飛と横歩を取れる。後手が自分の歩交換を遅らせた分、通常の横歩取りと条件が異なる。３三角へ進めば空中戦法へ近づくが、角交換から４五角や２五角で飛車を狙う反撃も用意されている。
paragraphs.en: An early defensive pawn on 23 lets the first player capture the side pawn before the second player exchanges the rook pawn. This changes the balance of development compared with normal Side Pawn Capture. A bishop on 33 can lead toward the aerial system, but the defender may instead exchange bishops and drop on 45 or 25 to attack the advanced rook.

paragraphs.ja: ４五角には３五飛から馬を作らせ、１五角の王手と３六歩で馬を狭くする筋がある。２五角には３二飛成で金を取り、３八銀で成り込みを防ぐ別の構想になる。さらに１六歩と３五金で角を追う。飛車を切る分岐は持ち駒と角の逃げ道を読んでから選ぶ。
paragraphs.en: Against 45-bishop, retreating the rook to 35 can allow a horse while a checking bishop drop on 15 and 36-pawn restrict it. Against 25-bishop, a rook-for-gold sacrifice on 32 gives a different plan: develop 38-silver to prevent promotion, then use 16-pawn and a gold drop on 35 to chase the bishop. Calculate the drops and escape squares first.

question.ja: ４五角から２七に馬を作られたとき、１五角と３六歩の組合せは何を狙う？
question.en: What do 15-bishop and 36-pawn aim to achieve against the horse on 27?

answer.ja: 王手で一手稼ぎ、飛車・角・歩の利きで馬の逃げ道を狭める。
answer.en: The check gains a tempo while rook, bishop and pawn control restrict the horse’s escape squares.

notes.ja: 早い２三歩で、通常の横歩取りとは違う手数関係になる。

notes.ja: 角を88へ進める。成って働きを強める。
notes.en: Move the bishop to 88 and promote.

notes.ja: 角を27へ進める。成って働きを強める。
notes.en: Move the bishop to 27 and promote.

notes.ja: １五角で相手玉への斜線を作り、馬への対抗を狙う。
notes.en: Bishop*15 creates a diagonal toward the enemy king to counter the horse.

title.ja: 横歩取り△4五角戦法
title.en: Side Pawn Capture: the 45-bishop system

paragraphs.ja: ４五角戦法は角交換後に２八歩を捨て、同銀と取らせてから４五へ角を打つ。飛車取りと６七への成り込みを両方見せる。２八銀が先手飛車の深い退路を塞ぐため、歩の捨て手が攻めの仕組みに直結する。形だけ覚えず、この退路封鎖を理解しよう。
paragraphs.en: The 45-bishop system exchanges bishops, sacrifices a pawn on 28 to draw the silver there, then drops a bishop on 45. The bishop attacks the rook and threatens promotion toward 67. The silver on 28 blocks the rook’s deep retreat, so the pawn sacrifice is an essential part of the mechanism rather than a decorative move before the attack.

paragraphs.ja: 先手は２四飛に逃げ、２三歩には７七角を打って攻め合う筋がある。双方の飛車を交換し、角で香を取り馬を作った後、３六香で桂を狙う。相手の８七銀を反射的に金で取ると飛車打ちの王手が残ることもある。馬を自陣へ戻す受けと攻め合いの速度を比較する。
paragraphs.en: The first player can retreat to 24 and answer 23-pawn with a bishop drop on 77, entering a sharp exchange of rooks. The bishop then captures a lance and promotes; a lance drop on 36 pressures the knight. Later silver offers on 87 may conceal checking rook drops. Compare defensive horse retreats with counterattack speed instead of automatically accepting apparently free material.

question.ja: ２八歩・同銀を先に入れる理由は？
question.en: Why insert …28-pawn and the silver recapture before …45-bishop?

answer.ja: 銀を２八へ呼び、先手の飛車が２八へ引いて守る退路を塞ぐ。
answer.en: It draws the silver to 28 and blocks the rook’s defensive retreat to that square.

７七角は飛車への応対と角の働きを同時に確保する。
notes.en: Bishop*77 meets the rook pressure while activating the bishop.

title.ja: 相横歩取り
title.en: Double Side Pawn Capture

paragraphs.ja: 相横歩取りでは後手が先に角交換してから７六飛と横歩を取る。角を残して単に取る形とは異なる。先手の７七銀は金への攻めを防ぎながら飛車を追い、後手の逃げ場所を限定する。２六飛には１五角、７五飛には２二歩が厳しく、７四飛が基本になる。
paragraphs.en: Double Side Pawn Capture has the second player exchange bishops before taking the pawn on 76. This differs tactically from taking it while the bishops remain on the board. The first player develops 77-silver to defend the gold and chase the rook. Retreats to 26 allow a checking bishop fork; 75 permits a threatening pawn drop on 22, making 74 the main retreat.

paragraphs.ja: ７四で飛車を交換して４六角を打つと、９一の香を狙いながら８筋に働きかける。８二歩には８三歩と迫り、８二角なら交換してから５五角などを考える。最初から５五角の両取りを狙うと８五飛の切り返しがあり、角打ちの場所だけで成否が変わる。
paragraphs.en: After a rook exchange on 74, a bishop drop on 46 pressures the lance on 91 and the eighth file. An 82-pawn defense can be met by pawn pressure on 83; an 82-bishop may lead to another bishop exchange. The superficially stronger immediate 55-bishop fork allows an 85-rook counterattack, showing why the bishop’s exact placement matters as much as the material it threatens.

question.ja: 飛車交換後、すぐ５五角ではなく４六角を考える理由は？
question.en: Why consider 46-bishop rather than an immediate 55-bishop after exchanging rooks?

answer.ja: ５五角には８五飛の角桂両取りなどの反撃があり、香の両取りだけでは評価できない。
answer.en: The 55-bishop permits counterplay with an 85-rook drop; threatening both lances does not by itself make the move stronger.

title.en: Double Side Pawn Capture: the plan on the board

notes.ja: 角を88へ進める。成って働きを強める。

notes.en: White also takes a side pawn, leading toward a sharp rook exchange.

notes.ja: ４六角で飛車を手にした後の攻撃を作る。
notes.en: Bishop*46 starts the attack after obtaining a rook in hand.

title.ja: 横歩取り △3三角型空中戦法
title.en: Side Pawn Capture: the 33-bishop aerial system

paragraphs.ja: ３三角型では先手が３六飛へ引き、７六の横歩を守る。後手が８四飛に引いて２四への転回を狙えば、先手も２六飛へ戻る。歩得と駒組みの手数が釣り合う展開で、飛車の横利きが序盤の守りを担う。８七歩の打ち戻しは角交換後の乱戦を抑える。
paragraphs.en: In the 33-bishop aerial system, the first player commonly retreats the rook to 36 to protect the side pawn on 76. When the opposing rook retreats to 84 and threatens to transfer to 24, returning to 26 contests that file. The extra pawn is balanced against development time; lateral rook control plays a major defensive role before castling.

paragraphs.ja: 中住まいは玉を５八へ一手進め、中央の歩と自陣の打ち込みを支える。そこから３八金・４八銀の金開きに整える。８七歩を省くと角交換から４四角などの飛車取りと自陣侵入が生じる。小さな手順差で乱戦になるため、攻め駒だけでなく玉と金の利きも確認する。
paragraphs.en: A defensive pawn on 87 restrains sharp bishop-exchange lines. Central King development to 58 supports central pawns and reduces invasion squares, after which 38-gold and 48-silver form an open-gold arrangement. Omitting the pawn block can permit a bishop drop that attacks both rook and home camp. Recheck king and gold coverage whenever a “natural” move changes the tactical position.

question.ja: ３六飛へ引く最初の役割は？
question.en: What is the first purpose of the retreat to 36-rook?

answer.ja: ７六の横歩を横利きで守り、後手の７六飛を防ぐ。
answer.en: It protects the side pawn on 76 with lateral rook control.

title.ja: 横歩取り △3三角型空中戦法：局面の狙い
title.en: Side Pawn Capture: the 33-bishop aerial system: the plan on the board

notes.ja: ８四へ浮き飛車を引き、横の守りと反撃を残す。
notes.en: Retreat the floating rook to 84 to retain lateral defense and counterplay.

notes.ja: ２六飛で空中戦の形を作り、横の働きを使う。
notes.en: Rook-26 establishes the aerial formation and uses the rook’s lateral activity.

title.ja: 横歩取り青野流
title.en: Side Pawn Capture: the Aono strategy

paragraphs.ja: 青野流は横歩取りの３三角型で、飛車をすぐ引かず５八玉と上がる。３六歩・３七桂を急ぎ、４五桂で角と５三を狙う。後手に横歩を取らせる場合もあり、歩より攻めの速度を重視する。ただし７八金を角交換後の飛車で狙われるので、受けの準備も必要。
paragraphs.en: The Aono strategy answers 33-bishop with 58-king instead of immediately retreating the rook. Develop 36-pawn and 37-knight quickly, aiming for 45-knight against the bishop and central pawn. Allowing the opponent to recover a side pawn can buy attacking time. The gold on 78 still needs protection against a bishop exchange followed by rook capture, so speed does not remove defensive obligations.

paragraphs.ja: ２二歩で金銀を動かしてから４五桂と跳ねる筋、左右の桂を五段目へ出す天使の跳躍が代表的。銀で飛車を追われても別の筋へ回って桂を使う。角交換から５五角の両狙いには２二歩などで対抗する。理想形の名前だけで有利を決めず、桂の支えと相手の切り返しを読む。
paragraphs.en: Typical attacks use a pawn drop on 22 to displace a defender before the knight jump. Activating both knights on the fifth rank gives the “angel’s leap” ideal, while rook transfers keep the knight attack alive against silver pressure. Bishop exchanges and a 55-bishop drop create sharp counterplay; calculate checking threats, loose knights and pawn-drop resources rather than assuming the ideal formation guarantees victory.

question.ja: 青野流の玉の位置と基本の攻め駒は？
question.en: Where does the Aono king develop, and which piece drives its basic attack?

answer.ja: ５八玉。３六歩・３七桂から４五桂を狙う右桂が攻めの軸。
answer.en: The king goes to 58; the right knight develops through 37 toward 45.

title.ja: 横歩取り青野流：局面の狙い
title.en: Side Pawn Capture: the Aono strategy: the plan on the board

notes.ja: ５八玉は青野流の中央配置。囲いより速い攻めを選ぶ。
notes.en: King-58 is Aono’s central placement, prioritizing a quick attack over extensive castling.

notes.ja: ４五桂で３三角を攻め、横歩を取った飛車と協力する。
notes.en: Knight-45 attacks Bishop-33 and coordinates with the side-pawn rook.

title.ja: 横歩取り勇気流
title.en: Side Pawn Capture: the Yūki strategy

paragraphs.ja: 勇気流は３三角型に６八玉と寄り、７八金を玉で支える。青野流の５八玉と比べ、角交換後に金を狙う飛車への受けを一手省ける。３六歩・３七桂から４五桂を急ぐ攻めは共通するが、玉の位置の違いで角打ちへの対応が変わる。
paragraphs.en: The Yūki strategy develops the king to 68 against the 33-bishop system. Unlike Aono’s king on 58, this king directly supports the gold on 78, reducing the need for an extra defense against the opposing rook after a bishop exchange. The attacking plan still emphasizes 36-pawn, 37-knight and a rapid 45-knight jump, but the changed king square alters bishop-drop tactics.

paragraphs.ja: ６八玉は４九金を支えないので、早い角交換から２七角を打たれれば３八銀などで対応する。飛車を８四へ回ると９五角の王手飛車にも注意が必要。２二歩の叩きで守りを動かして桂を跳ねる狙いは、相手が平凡に囲うと厳しい。攻めの前に金と玉の斜めの弱点を点検する。
paragraphs.en: A bishop drop on 27 can attack the gold on 49, which the king no longer supports; 38-silver is one response. Transferring the rook to 84 can expose a checking bishop fork on 95. A pawn drop on 22 followed by the knight jump is powerful against passive development, but inspect the uncovered king diagonal and gold before selecting the attacking move order.

question.ja: ６八玉は青野流の５八玉と比べてどの金を支える？
question.en: Which gold does 68-king support that Aono’s 58-king does not?

answer.ja: ７八金。その代わり４九金への支えがなく、角打ちの弱点も変わる。
answer.en: The gold on 78. It no longer supports 49-gold, so bishop-drop weaknesses change.

title.ja: 横歩取り勇気流：局面の狙い
title.en: Side Pawn Capture: the Yūki strategy: the plan on the board

notes.ja: 勇気流では６八玉とし、青野流とは違う玉の位置を選ぶ。
notes.en: Yūki’s strategy places the king on 68, choosing a different king position from Aono.

notes.ja: ４五桂で角を追い、飛車と桂の速い攻めを目指す。
notes.en: Knight-45 chases the bishop and prepares a fast rook-and-knight attack.

title.ja: 横歩取りを拒否する指し方
title.en: Ways to avoid Side Pawn Capture

paragraphs.ja: 横歩取りを避けたい先手は、歩交換前に６六歩で角道を止め、７七角で飛車先を受けて雁木などへ進める。自分から角交換して角換わりへ変える選択もあるが、相手の銀の進出を助けて一手失う。回避できることと、その後の駒組みを知っていることは別。
paragraphs.en: To avoid Side Pawn Capture, the first player can close the bishop diagonal with 66-pawn before the exchanges and defend the rook file with 77-bishop, heading toward Gangi. Initiating a bishop exchange is another option, but helps the opponent’s silver develop and concedes a tempo. Avoidance chooses a different opening; it does not replace learning the resulting formation and its tactical risks.

paragraphs.ja: 双方が飛車先を交換した後でも、横歩を取らず２六飛に引けば相掛かり風の展開になる。後手なら４四歩で角道を閉じる、または一手損角換わりへ変える方法がある。２五歩を早く決める回避策は２五桂の場所を失うので、自分の攻めの選択肢まで比較して決めよう。
paragraphs.en: Even after both rook-pawn exchanges, retreating to 26 instead of taking the side pawn can give Double Wing-style play. As second player, close the diagonal with 44-pawn or choose One-tempo-loss Bishop Exchange. An early advance to 25 may also steer development but occupies a potential knight square. Compare the attacking options sacrificed by each avoidance method, not just the unwanted opening’s name.

question.ja: 双方の歩交換後、横歩を取らず回避するには？
question.en: How can the first player decline the side pawn after both rook-pawn exchanges?

answer.ja: ３四飛ではなく２六飛などへ引く。相掛かりに似た構想へ移る。
answer.en: Retreat the rook, for example to 26, rather than capture on 34, then use a Double Wing-style plan.

title.ja: 横歩取りを拒否する指し方：局面の狙い
title.en: Ways to avoid Side Pawn Capture: the plan on the board

notes.ja: ６六歩で角道を閉じ、横歩取りの出だしを避ける。
notes.en: Pawn-66 closes the bishop diagonal and avoids the usual Side Pawn Capture opening.

notes.ja: ７七角で飛車先を守り、閉じた角道の駒組みを進める。
notes.en: Bishop-77 defends the rook file while continuing closed-diagonal development.

title.ja: 対振り飛車の基本、最初の駒組み
title.en: Static Rook against Ranging Rook: the foundation

paragraphs.ja: 相手が４四歩で角道を閉じても、まだ飛車を振ったとは限らない。４八銀で様子を見て、４二飛などを確認してから舟囲いへ進む。玉を６八・７八へ寄せ、５六歩で銀の通路を空ける。５七銀は攻めにも守りにも使え、相手の飛車位置に合わせて役割を決められる。
paragraphs.en: A closed enemy bishop diagonal suggests Ranging Rook but does not prove it. Develop 48-silver while waiting to see the rook move, then castle toward 78 with a Boat formation. Advancing 56-pawn opens a route for a silver to 57. That square supports several attacking and defensive arrangements, preserving flexibility until the opponent’s formation clarifies the appropriate plan.

paragraphs.ja: ４六銀と３五歩が基本の攻めだが、相手の銀の位置で順序が変わる。４三銀型には銀を出してから歩を突き、３二銀型には先に歩を捨てる。後者で先に銀を出すと４五歩に追われ、飛車が４筋へ直通するため同銀で取れない。形の似た急戦でも順番を区別する。
paragraphs.en: A typical attack uses 46-silver and 35-pawn, but the order depends on the opposing silver. Against 43-silver, advance the silver first; against 32-silver, sacrifice the third-file pawn first. Advancing the silver prematurely against the latter permits 45-pawn to chase it while the opposing rook controls the fourth file. Similar-looking rapid attacks therefore need different move orders.

question.ja: 相手の銀が３二にいるとき、４六銀と３五歩の順番は？
question.en: Against a silver on 32, which comes first: 46-silver or 35-pawn?

answer.ja: ３五歩の突き捨てを先にする。４六銀を先に出すと４五歩で追われる。
answer.en: Offer 35-pawn first; an immediate 46-silver allows …45-pawn to chase it.

title.ja: 対振り棒銀
title.en: Climbing Silver against Fourth-file Rook

paragraphs.ja: 対振り棒銀は３六歩と３七銀から２六銀へ出し、飛車・銀・歩を同じ方面に集める。舟囲いを金銀で補強してから３五歩で仕掛ける。相手が同歩と取れば銀が五段目へ進めるが、３二飛へ回って争点を守る受けがある。そこでこちらも３八飛と回る。
paragraphs.en: Against Fourth-file Rook, Climbing Silver develops through 37 toward 26 and concentrates rook, silver and pawn on the attacking wing. Strengthen the Boat castle before offering 35-pawn. A pawn capture may let the silver reach the fifth rank, but the defender can shift the rook to 32 instead. Moving your rook to 38 then concentrates force on the new contact file.

paragraphs.ja: 相手が角を４二へ引くと、３筋の飛車の通路が開いて反撃を狙われる。４六歩で角道を利用する準備をし、３四歩で銀を逸らしてから４五歩を考える。５五歩で角を呼び金を前へ出す防御もあり、単純な交換では美濃の堅さが効く。急戦は囲い差を補う攻めの継続が必要。
paragraphs.en: A bishop retreat to 42 opens the defending rook’s third file and prepares counterplay. Develop 46-pawn, then consider diverting the silver with 34-pawn before the fourth-file break. The defender can offer a central pawn and advance a gold, complicating the attack. A simple major-piece exchange may favor the stronger Mino castle; your attack must justify the difference in king safety.

question.ja: ３五歩を取らず３二飛とされたら、なぜ３八飛を考える？
question.en: Why consider 38-rook when the defender answers 35-pawn with …32-rook?

answer.ja: ３筋の争点へ飛車の利きを足し、銀だけでの無理な突破を避けるため。
answer.en: It adds rook support to the third-file contact point instead of forcing an unsupported silver breakthrough.

title.ja: 対振り斜め棒銀 ▲4六銀左急戦
title.en: Diagonal Climbing Silver: the left-silver rapid attack

paragraphs.ja: ４六銀左急戦は左銀を６八・５七・４六と前へ使い、右銀を守りに残す。４三銀型には４六銀から３五歩、３二銀型には３五歩の突き捨てから４六銀と順番を変える。山田定跡の要点は、相手の飛車が４筋に直通する形で銀を不用意に追わせないこと。
paragraphs.en: The left-silver rapid attack develops through 68, 57 and 46 while retaining the other silver for defense. Against 43-silver, advance to 46 before offering 35-pawn; against 32-silver, reverse that order. The latter is a Yamada-joseki pattern. The difference concerns fourth-file rook control and whether an enemy pawn advance can chase your silver with tempo.

paragraphs.ja: ３二飛で受けられたら、３四を取り込む前に２四歩を捨てておく。大駒交換後に２四飛へ転じる道を作るため。４五歩で角道を開けられた時、銀を飛車で取るだけでは角交換の王手で飛車を素抜かれる。自分から角交換して玉を囲いに残す順を比較しよう。
paragraphs.en: If the defender shifts to 32-rook, offer the second-file pawn before advancing on 34; it leaves a later route for your rook toward 24 after the exchanges. When …45-pawn opens the bishop diagonal, grabbing a silver with the rook can permit a checking bishop exchange and loss of the rook. Initiating the bishop trade can keep your king inside its castle.

question.ja: ３四歩の取り込み前に２四歩を捨てる目的は？
question.en: Why sacrifice 24-pawn before capturing on the third file?

answer.ja: 後の交換で２四飛へ回る道と標的を残し、攻めを継続するため。
answer.en: To preserve a later rook transfer to 24 and keep the attack going after the third-file exchanges.

title.ja: elmo囲い急戦
title.en: The elmo castle rapid attack

paragraphs.ja: elmo囲いは舟囲いから６八銀・７九金を組み、必要なら右金を５九へ寄せる。５八金を先に決めず、５七銀を攻めへ出す点が特徴。金二枚と銀一枚を玉の後方でつなぎ、舟囲いより飛車打ちへの抵抗を高めながら急戦の速度を保つ。
paragraphs.en: The elmo castle uses 68-silver and 79-gold, optionally bringing the other gold to 59. Avoid committing that gold to 58 too early; the silver on 57 is intended for the attack. Two golds and one silver coordinate behind the king, giving stronger resistance to rook drops than a plain Boat castle while retaining enough speed for rapid play.

paragraphs.ja: 攻めは斜め棒銀、４五歩早仕掛け、右四間などを組み合わせる。４五歩型ではすぐ取り込まず桂を跳ね、２筋を捨ててから仕掛ける手もある。囲いが強化されても攻めの定跡が省略できるわけではない。大駒の交換後に金銀が離れないか、中央の歩を攻められないかも確かめる。
paragraphs.en: It can support Diagonal Climbing Silver, an early 45-pawn attack or Right Fourth-file Rook. In the pawn-break version, developing the knight and offering the second-file pawn may be preferable to immediately capturing forward. The stronger castle does not excuse skipping attacking prerequisites. After major-piece exchanges, check whether the golds and silver stay connected and whether central pawn pressure creates a new entry point.

question.ja: elmo囲いで５七銀は主に守りか攻めか？
question.en: Is the silver on 57 mainly a defender or attacker in this elmo setup?

answer.ja: 攻めに使う。玉は６八銀と７九金、必要なら５九金で支える。
answer.en: It joins the attack; 68-silver and 79-gold, optionally with 59-gold, support the king.

title.ja: elmo囲い急戦：局面の狙い
title.en: The elmo castle rapid attack: the plan on the board

notes.ja: ６九の金を７九へ寄せ、elmo囲いを作る。
notes.en: Move the left gold to 79 to form the elmo castle.

notes.ja: 右金を５九へ寄せ、左銀６八と金７九を支える。
notes.en: Gold-59 supports Silver-68 and Gold-79 in elmo’s compact defense.

title.ja: 対振り持久戦 居飛車穴熊
title.en: Static Rook Anaguma against Ranging Rook

paragraphs.ja: 居飛車穴熊は５七銀と７七角で玉の通路を空け、８八玉・９八香・９九玉から８八銀で蓋をする。金を７九や７八へ寄せると、大駒交換後の攻め合いで玉の遠さが働く。組む途中は手数がかかるため、相手が桂と角で急いで攻める形を見落とさない。
paragraphs.en: Static Rook Anaguma develops 57-silver and 77-bishop to clear the king’s path, then uses 88-king, 98-lance, 99-king and 88-silver to seal the corner. Bringing golds close to the castle makes the king distant from the main battle after major-piece exchanges. The formation takes time, so inspect opposing knight and bishop pressure before committing the king to its construction.

paragraphs.ja: 振り飛車側の早い７三桂は６五桂の両取りを見せ、６六歩を指させて角道を閉じる。４五歩から銀を進め、と金を作る反撃もある。松尾流は５七銀を６八・７九へ引いて四枚で守り、銀交換の標的を消す構想。囲いの堅さだけでなく攻めの道も残す。
paragraphs.en: A rapid opposing knight on 73 can threaten a fork on 65, inducing 66-pawn and closing your bishop diagonal. The defender may then open its own diagonal and advance a silver to create a promoted pawn. Matsuo-style Anaguma retreats the 57-silver into the castle, giving four defenders and removing an exchange target. Preserve an attacking route rather than treating castle hardness as a winning condition.

question.ja: 穴熊を組む前に７七角を上がる目的は？
question.en: Why develop the bishop to 77 before constructing Anaguma?

answer.ja: ８八を空けて玉の通路を作る。５七銀は急な４筋の攻めへの受けも担う。
answer.en: It clears 88 for the king’s route, while 57-silver helps meet early fourth-file pressure.

title.ja: 対振り持久戦 ミレニアム囲い（トーチカ）
title.en: The Millennium castle against Ranging Rook

paragraphs.ja: ミレニアムは玉を８九へ置き、相手の角の斜線から外す囲い。６六角・７七桂で玉の入る場所を空け、金銀を７九・７八・８八などへつなぐ。穴熊ほど深くはないが、藤井システムの斜めと端を組み合わせた攻めを受ける狙いがあり、８五桂へ桂で応じやすい。
paragraphs.en: Millennium places the king on 89, outside the opposing bishop’s main diagonal. Develop 66-bishop and 77-knight to clear the king’s square, then connect the nearby golds and silver. It is less buried than Anaguma but addresses the diagonal and edge pressure associated with the Fujii System. The knight on 77 can also meet an opposing jump to 85 directly.

paragraphs.ja: 右銀を守りへ使うなら５九から６八へ回す。５七銀を置くと６六角が６五歩で追われた時の退路を塞ぐため、５七を空ける。角を５七へ引いた後は２四歩から角を活用して交換を狙える。囲いの完成図と同じくらい、角の逃げ場所を駒組み中に保つことが大切。
paragraphs.en: When adding the right silver to the defense, route it through 59 to 68 instead of occupying 57. A silver on 57 blocks the bishop’s retreat when a pawn on 65 attacks it. Keeping 57 free lets the bishop withdraw and later support a second-file pawn exchange. Castle development must preserve that escape route, not merely reproduce the final defender arrangement.

question.ja: ５七銀を避ける理由は？
question.en: Why avoid placing a silver on 57 during this Millennium construction?

answer.ja: ６六角が６五歩で追われた際、５七角へ引けるようにするため。
answer.en: To leave 57 available for the bishop’s retreat when a pawn on 65 attacks the bishop on 66.

title.ja: 対振り持久戦 ミレニアム囲い（トーチカ）：局面の狙い
title.en: The Millennium castle against Ranging Rook: the plan on the board

notes.ja: 玉を８九へ置き、角の斜線を避けるミレニアムを目指す。
notes.en: King-89 aims for Millennium, avoiding the opponent’s bishop diagonal.

notes.ja: 右銀を６八へ移し、玉の周りの金銀を増やす。
notes.en: Develop the right silver to 68, adding a defender around the king.

title.ja: vs四間飛車　4五歩早仕掛け
title.en: The early 45-pawn attack against Fourth-file Rook

paragraphs.ja: ４五歩早仕掛けは３三角を交換へ誘い、２筋の飛車先を突破する。４六歩・４五歩と進めてもすぐ４四を取らず、３七桂で力をためる。２四歩の突き捨てから相手が歩で取るか角で取るかを見て、角道を開く方法とその後の攻めを選ぶ。
paragraphs.en: The early 45-pawn attack tries to remove the bishop on 33 through an exchange, opening the rook’s second file. Advance the fourth-file pawn but develop 37-knight before immediately capturing on 44. Then offer 24-pawn and distinguish a pawn recapture from a bishop recapture. These responses lead to different ways of opening the bishop diagonal and maintaining the attack.

paragraphs.ja: 歩で取られた形は４四歩・同銀・４五歩で銀を動かし、角交換後７七角を打つ筋がある。角で取られた形は４三歩で飛車を誘い、角を飛車で取って３二角の両取りを狙う。相手の自陣飛車打ちで馬を閉じ込められる反撃もあるので、大駒交換後まで読んで仕掛ける。
paragraphs.en: After a pawn recapture, 44-pawn and a further pawn drop can displace the silver before a bishop exchange and 77-bishop drop. After a bishop recapture, a pawn on 43 can draw the defending rook out and prepare a bishop fork on 32. The opponent may trap your promoted bishop with defensive rook drops, so calculate beyond the apparent breakthrough and include reserve-pawn resources.

question.ja: ４五歩を突いた後、すぐ４四を取らず３七桂を入れる意味は？
question.en: Why develop 37-knight instead of immediately capturing on 44 after 45-pawn?

answer.ja: 攻めの利きを増やし、歩交換と角交換後の攻めを強くするため。
answer.en: It adds attacking force before the pawn and bishop exchanges, improving the follow-up attack.

title.ja: vs四間飛車 ポンポン桂（富沢キック）
title.en: Bouncing Knight: the Tomizawa kick

paragraphs.ja: ポンポン桂は３七桂から４五桂と桂を捨て、相手の４四歩に取らせて角道を開く。角交換で３三角をどかしたら２筋を突破する。舟囲いを補強してから仕掛け、桂損を補う攻めの継続が必要。桂を跳ねる派手さではなく、角道を強制的に開くことが目的。
paragraphs.en: Bouncing Knight sacrifices the knight from 37 on 45, inviting the fourth-file pawn to capture and open the bishop diagonal. The ensuing bishop exchange removes the defender on 33 and enables a second-file breakthrough. Strengthen the Boat castle before starting; the knight deficit demands continued activity. The jump’s purpose is to force open the diagonal, not simply to attack with the knight.

paragraphs.ja: 相手の６四歩が重要な条件。６四が空いていれば角交換後に６四角を打つ反撃があり、桂捨てが悪くなりやすい。歩が６四を埋めているのを確認しよう。突破後も４一飛と４二金でじっくり受けられると攻めが止まることがある。条件が合わなければ４五歩早仕掛けへ切り替える。
paragraphs.en: An opposing pawn on 64 is a crucial prerequisite: without it, a bishop drop on 64 can refute the attacking sequence. Even after breaking through, a rook retreat to 41 followed by 42-gold may contain the attack. Check both the available bishop-drop square and the next defensive formation. If those conditions favor the defender, switch to the early 45-pawn plan instead.

question.ja: 仕掛け前に相手の６四歩を確認するのはなぜ？
question.en: Why check for the opposing pawn on 64 before the knight sacrifice?

answer.ja: ６四角の反撃の打ち場所を塞いでいるか確認するため。
answer.en: It verifies that the dangerous counterattacking bishop-drop square on 64 is occupied.

title.ja: vs早石田 △4五角からの乱戦
title.en: Meeting Early Ishida with a bishop on 45

paragraphs.ja: 早石田に対する△４二玉は、角交換後の反撃を支える一手です。▲７八飛に角を交換し、△４五角と打つと、６七と２七の両方への成り込みを狙えます。先手は▲６八金で片方を守り、馬を作らせる間に７筋を突いて反撃します。
paragraphs.en: Against Early Ishida, moving White’s king to 42 gives the bishop counterattack a safer foundation. Exchange bishops after Black swings the rook to 78, then drop a bishop on 45 to threaten promotion on both 67 and 27. Black can defend one target with Gold-68 and counterattack on the seventh file while White makes a horse.

paragraphs.ja: ▲５五角の飛車香両取りには△３三桂が備えになります。先手が▲７四飛と走ったときは、△９二飛で角筋から逃げます。▲３四飛には△３二金で守りを整えます。先手の▲３六歩は、馬による飛車角両取りを防ぐ意味もあります。双方の大駒が働く乱戦で、馬を作っただけでは勝負は決まりません。
paragraphs.en: Black’s Bishop*55 attacks rook and lance, so White develops the knight to 33. Against Rook-74, retreating to 92 escapes the bishop’s diagonal; Black can then take the side pawn on 34 while White secures the king with Gold-32. Black’s Pawn-36 also limits a horse fork. This is an active, exposed battle: making a horse does not by itself settle the result.

question.ja: △４五角は何を狙いますか？
question.en: What does Bishop*45 threaten?

answer.ja: ６七と２七の二か所への成り込みです。
answer.en: Promotion on either 67 or 27.

title.ja: vs早石田 △4五角からの乱戦：局面の狙い
title.en: Meeting Early Ishida with a bishop on 45: the plan on the board

notes.ja: 角を88へ進める。成って働きを強める。
notes.en: Move the bishop to 88 and promote.

notes.ja: ４五角は６七と２七の両方を狙う。４二玉が反撃を支える。
notes.en: Bishop*45 attacks both 67 and 27; King-42 supports White’s counterplay.

notes.ja: 角を27へ進める。成って働きを強める。
notes.en: Move the bishop to 27 and promote.

notes.ja: ９二飛で５五角の斜線から逃げ、飛車を温存する。
notes.en: Rook-92 escapes Bishop-55’s diagonal and preserves the rook.

title.ja: vs石田流　棒金戦法
title.en: Climbing Gold against Ishida

paragraphs.ja: 棒金は、石田流の浮き飛車を金で追い、７筋を押さえる作戦です。△６三銀で７四を守り、右金を７二、８三、７四へ運びます。相手の▲７五歩には金を横に逃がし、飛車を７筋に回して金と協力させます。
paragraphs.en: Climbing Gold attacks Ishida’s floating rook and restricts the seventh file. White places a silver on 63 to protect 74, then brings the right gold through 72 and 83 toward 74. When Black pushes Pawn-75 to chase it, the gold can move sideways rather than retreat all the way home. A rook on the seventh file supports this restraint.

paragraphs.ja: 本組みの▲９七角には端歩から角を追う手もあります。駒得を急いで大駒を交換すると、石田流側の捌きを助けてしまいます。▲６五歩から銀を狙われても、７筋の制圧を優先できる形があります。ただし角が８八に残る陣形では角の反撃が違うため、棒金を同じ手順で決めつけてはいけません。
paragraphs.en: Against a bishop on 97, edge pawns can help drive the bishop backward. Avoid exchanging major pieces merely to collect material: those exchanges may release Black’s cramped army. A central pawn challenge also requires comparing silver safety with seventh-file control. The plan depends on Black’s formation; a bishop retained on 88 gives different counterplay from the fully developed Ishida bishop on 97.

question.ja: 棒金で大駒交換を急がない理由は？
question.en: Why should Climbing Gold avoid rushing major-piece exchanges?

answer.ja: 石田流の飛車角を捌かせ、押さえ込みを失うためです。
answer.en: They can free Ishida’s rook and bishop and undo the restraint.

title.ja: vs石田流　棒金戦法：局面の狙い
title.en: Climbing Gold against Ishida: the plan on the board

notes.ja: 金を８三へ運び、７四への進出を準備する。
notes.en: Bring the gold to 83, preparing its advance to 74.

notes.ja: ７四金が浮き飛車を圧迫する。大駒交換で捌かせないようにする。
notes.en: Gold-74 pressures the floating rook; avoid releasing it through major-piece exchanges.

title.ja: vsゴキゲン中飛車 超速2枚銀
title.en: Two-Silver Chousoku against Gokigen Central Rook

paragraphs.ja: 超速は右銀を３七から４六へ急ぎ、中央の歩を圧迫します。左銀も７七から６六へ進める二枚銀では、二枚の銀と角筋で５五を争います。ゴキゲン中飛車側が４四銀を加えると中央の守りも増えるので、駒の数だけを見て単純に取り込むことはできません。
paragraphs.en: Chousoku develops the right silver rapidly through 37 to 46 against Gokigen Central Rook. Bringing the left silver through 77 to 66 creates a two-silver formation aimed at the central pawn. The bishop diagonal participates when the left silver advances and clears its path. White’s defensive Silver-44 adds another central defender, so count the resulting exchanges rather than assuming two silvers guarantee a breakthrough.

paragraphs.ja: ▲３七桂から４五へ跳ねると３三の角を動かせます。仕掛け前の▲２九飛は、中央が開いた後の角打ちによる飛車銀両取りを避ける準備です。角が２二へ引く場合と４二へ引く場合では攻め筋が変わります。中央の歩交換や角交換の順番を確認して、銀の進出と桂の攻撃をつなげます。
paragraphs.en: A knight developed to 37 can jump to 45 and force the bishop off 33. Retreating the rook to 29 before opening the center reduces bishop-fork dangers against rook and silver. The attack changes when White retreats the bishop to 22 or 42. Coordinate the knight pressure with the silvers, and check whether a central pawn exchange opens a useful diagonal for the opponent.

question.ja: ▲２九飛を先に指す狙いは？
question.en: Why retreat the rook to 29 before attacking?

answer.ja: 中央が開いた後の角による飛車銀両取りを避けます。
answer.en: To reduce bishop forks against the rook and silver after the center opens.

title.ja: vsゴキゲン中飛車 超速2枚銀：局面の狙い
title.en: Two-Silver Chousoku against Gokigen Central Rook: the plan on the board

notes.ja: 左銀を６六へ進め、右銀４六と中央の歩を狙う。
notes.en: Advance the left silver to 66 to attack the central pawn with Silver-46.

notes.ja: ４五桂で３三角を追う。２九飛が角の反撃への備えになる。
notes.en: Knight-45 chases Bishop-33; Rook-29 prepares against bishop counterplay.

title.ja: vs角交換四間飛車　4七銀型
title.en: Silver-47 against Bishop-Exchange Fourth File Rook

paragraphs.ja: 角交換四間飛車に対して、居飛車は４筋の歩を進めて銀を４七へ置きます。相手が２筋へ振り直して逆棒銀を狙うとき、銀を３六へ出して２五を守れるのが特徴です。玉を８八まで囲うことだけを急ぐと、この受けの準備が間に合わない場合があります。
paragraphs.en: Against Bishop-Exchange Fourth File Rook, Static Rook advances the fourth-file pawn and places the right silver on 47. If White switches to the second file and prepares Reverse Climbing Silver, the silver can move to 36 and protect 25. Prepare this defensive route while castling; moving the king all the way to 88 too quickly may leave the rook-side defense unfinished.

paragraphs.ja: △２四歩から銀が進出しても、銀の支えを外す歩打ちや角打ちで反撃する形があります。ただし３二に金がいるかどうかで角打ちの成立は変わります。持久戦では銀を中央へ使い、平らな矢倉などに囲う選択もあります。相手が半美濃で中央を急ぐ場合は、４筋と５筋の圧力も確認します。
paragraphs.en: After White exchanges the second-file pawn and advances a silver, pawn offers and bishop drops can attack its support. Those tactics depend on whether White’s gold occupies 32. In a slower game, the silver can work centrally while Black develops a flatter Yagura-style castle. A half-Mino opponent may instead attack the fourth and fifth files early, so defending 25 alone is insufficient.

question.ja: ４七の銀を３六へ出すと何を守れますか？
question.en: What does Silver-36 defend?

answer.ja: 逆棒銀が狙う２五を守れます。
answer.en: The 25 square targeted by Reverse Climbing Silver.

title.ja: vs角交換四間飛車　4七銀型：局面の狙い

notes.en: Move the bishop to 88 and promote.

notes.en: Silver-47 prepares Silver-36 against Reverse Climbing Silver.

notes.ja: ３六銀が２五を守り、２四の銀の進出を抑える。
notes.en: Silver-36 defends 25 and restricts the silver on 24.

title.ja: 向かい飛車の駒組み
title.en: Opposing Rook: building the formation

paragraphs.ja: 向かい飛車は、相手の居飛車と同じ８筋に飛車を置きます。▲６六歩で角交換を防ぎ、▲７七角で８八を空けてから飛車を振ります。左銀は６七へ進めて角の頭を守ります。相手の飛車先が伸びたときも、角と銀が８筋の受けを分担します。
paragraphs.en: Opposing Rook places Black’s rook on the eighth file directly opposite White’s Static Rook. Close the bishop diagonal with Pawn-66, move the bishop to 77 to clear 88, and then swing the rook across. Develop the left silver to 67 to support the bishop’s head. The bishop and silver help meet White’s advanced rook pawn while the opposing rooks face one another.

paragraphs.ja: 囲いは玉２八、銀３八の片美濃が基本です。左金は囲いに寄せず７八へ置き、飛車を打ち込まれる隙を減らします。この配置は飛車交換を歓迎するための準備ですが、玉側の金銀が通常の美濃より少ない点には注意が必要です。飛車を交換する前に自陣の打ち込みと角筋を点検します。
paragraphs.en: The usual castle is Half-Mino, with king on 28 and silver on 38. Keep the left gold on 78 instead of attaching it to the castle: it restricts enemy rook drops and makes rook exchanges attractive. The tradeoff is fewer castle defenders than ordinary Mino. Before forcing a rook trade, inspect drop squares in your own camp and the opponent’s bishop diagonal.

question.ja: 左金を７八に置く狙いは？
question.en: Why place the left gold on 78?

answer.ja: 自陣への飛車打ちを制限し、飛車交換に備えます。
answer.en: To restrict enemy rook drops and prepare for rook exchanges.
