title.en: Opposing Rook: building the formation: the plan on the board

notes.ja: ８八へ飛車を振り、相手の飛車と同じ筋で向かい合う。
notes.en: Swing the rook to 88, facing the opposing rook on the same file.

notes.ja: ７八金で飛車の打ち込みを制限し、飛車交換に備える。
notes.en: Gold-78 restricts rook drops and prepares for a rook exchange.

title.ja: 向かい飛車の基本の攻め筋
title.en: Opposing Rook: exchanging and attacking

paragraphs.ja: 向かい飛車の基本の攻めは、▲８六歩から同飛と取って飛車交換を迫ることです。左金７八と片美濃が、自陣に飛車を打たれたときの備えになります。相手が５筋を開け、玉が４二に残る特殊な形では、同角が王手となって強い攻めにつながることもあります。
paragraphs.en: Opposing Rook attacks by pushing Pawn-86 and recapturing with the rook to offer an exchange. Gold-78 and Half-Mino help defend the camp when the opponent receives a rook in hand. In the specific position where White opens the fifth file while the king remains on 42, recapturing with the bishop can give check and create a powerful attack.

paragraphs.ja: 飛車交換を△８五歩の打ち直しで拒まれたら、一度飛車を引き、▲９六歩から９七桂を使います。桂が８五を支えれば、再び飛車をぶつけられます。相手も７三桂で対抗したときは、７筋の歩交換と歩打ちで桂頭を狙います。王手になる角筋や飛車の捕獲手順は、金銀の配置が変わると成立しないため局面ごとの確認が必要です。
paragraphs.en: If White refuses the trade with Pawn*85, retreat the rook and develop Knight-97 after Pawn-96. The knight supports another rook challenge on 85. Against White’s Knight-73, a seventh-file pawn exchange can provide a pawn to attack the knight’s head. Check the actual formation before relying on a checking bishop move or trapping a dropped rook; both depend on precise king and gold placement.

question.ja: 飛車交換を拒まれたら、どの桂を使いますか？
question.en: Which knight helps renew the rook challenge?

answer.ja: ９六歩から９七桂を使い、８五を支えます。
answer.en: Knight-97 after Pawn-96, supporting 85.

title.ja: 向かい飛車の基本の攻め筋：局面の狙い
title.en: Opposing Rook: exchanging and attacking: the plan on the board

notes.ja: 飛車をぶつける。７八金と片美濃が交換後の支え。
notes.en: Offer the rook exchange; Gold-78 and Half-Mino support the position afterward.

notes.ja: ５九金で６九の飛車の逃げ道を狭める。
notes.en: Gold-59 restricts the dropped rook’s escape routes from 69.

title.ja: ノーマル三間飛車、最初の駒組み
title.en: Normal Third File Rook: first development

paragraphs.ja: ノーマル三間飛車は、飛車を７八に置き、角道を閉じて組む振り飛車です。△８五歩には▲７七角で飛車先を受け、相手が角道を開けたら▲６六歩で角交換を防ぎます。角を上がる前に別の手を急ぐと、８筋の歩交換から飛車に侵入される危険があります。
paragraphs.en: Normal Third File Rook swings the rook to 78 and develops with a closed bishop diagonal. Answer White’s Pawn-85 with Bishop-77 to defend the rook file; once White opens the bishop diagonal, Pawn-66 prevents an exchange. These are responses to the opponent’s move order. Delaying the bishop’s development can allow an eighth-file pawn exchange and an invading rook before the defense is ready.

paragraphs.ja: 左銀を６八へ上げたら、美濃囲いを目指します。高美濃や銀冠へ発展させると上からの攻めに備えられますが、囲いに使う手数や下段の薄さが変わります。石田流のように飛車を７六へ浮く形と区別し、まずは７八飛と７七角の協力を覚えます。攻められたときは大駒を働かせる捌きが重要です。
paragraphs.en: After developing Silver-68, build Mino. High Mino and Silver Crown offer stronger upper defenses but require additional time and change the weaknesses underneath the castle. Distinguish this formation from Ishida’s floating rook on 76: begin by understanding how Rook-78 and Bishop-77 cooperate. When challenged, look for ways to activate the major pieces instead of simply defending each attacked square.

question.ja: △８五歩に▲７七角を優先する理由は？
question.en: Why prioritize Bishop-77 against Pawn-85?

answer.ja: ８六への飛車先の突破を角で受けるためです。
answer.en: The bishop defends against a rook-file breakthrough on 86.

title.ja: ノーマル三間飛車、最初の駒組み：局面の狙い
title.en: Normal Third File Rook: first development: the plan on the board

notes.ja: ７七角で８六への飛車先の突破を防ぐ。
notes.en: Bishop-77 prevents a rook-file breakthrough on 86.

notes.ja: ６六歩で角交換を防ぎ、受けの角を残す。
notes.en: Pawn-66 prevents a bishop exchange and retains the defending bishop.

title.ja: ノーマル三間飛車vs棒銀
title.en: Normal Third File Rook against Climbing Silver

paragraphs.ja: 棒銀に対しては、相手の銀が７三へ出たらこちらも６七銀を用意し、△８四銀には▲５六歩を突きます。５六歩は後で角を４六へ使うための準備です。△９四歩から９五銀を狙われたら▲９六歩で止めます。歩の支えがない９五銀は７七の角で取れます。
paragraphs.en: Against Climbing Silver, meet White’s Silver-73 by preparing Silver-67, and answer Silver-84 with Pawn-56. This central pawn move clears a future bishop route to 46. If White prepares Silver-95 with Pawn-94, Pawn-96 prevents that advance. Without pawn support, Silver-95 can simply be captured by the bishop on 77. The edge response limits the attacker’s options before the main confrontation.

paragraphs.ja: △７五歩には同歩と受け止めず、▲６八角と引く捌きがあります。△７六歩に▲４六角と出ると、８二の飛車をにらみながら７筋の飛車先を開けられます。銀が引いたら▲７六飛で歩を回収します。何でも歩で取ると、相手銀の進出と８筋からの攻めを助けることがあるため、角の逃げ道を先に作ります。
paragraphs.en: Against Pawn-75, Bishop-68 prepares a counterattack rather than accepting the pawn immediately. After White takes on 76, Bishop-46 looks toward the rook on 82 and clears the seventh file for Black’s rook. Once the silver retreats, Rook-76 recovers the pawn. Automatic pawn captures can help White’s silver advance and intensify the eighth-file attack, so preserve the bishop’s escape route first.

question.ja: ▲５六歩は後のどの手を準備しますか？
question.en: Which later move does Pawn-56 prepare?

answer.ja: ６八から４六へ角を出す手です。
answer.en: Bishop-46 from 68.

title.ja: ノーマル三間飛車vs棒銀：局面の狙い
title.en: Normal Third File Rook against Climbing Silver: the plan on the board

notes.ja: 歩を取る代わりに角を引き、飛車先を開ける。
notes.en: Retreat the bishop instead of capturing the pawn, clearing the rook file.

notes.ja: ５六歩で開けた道を使い、角が相手飛車を狙う。
notes.en: Use the diagonal cleared by Pawn-56 to attack the opposing rook.

title.ja: ノーマル三間飛車 トマホーク
title.en: Tomahawk against Static Rook Anaguma

paragraphs.ja: トマホークは、ノーマル三間飛車から右桂を１七、２五へ使い、穴熊の端を攻める作戦です。先に１筋の歩を伸ばし、相手が穴熊を目指すことを確かめます。左銀は６七、５六、４五へ進出し、相手が飛車を浮いて銀を止めたら桂の攻撃を組み合わせます。
paragraphs.en: Tomahawk develops from Normal Third File Rook and sends the right knight through 17 to 25 against Static Rook Anaguma. Advance the first-file pawn early and observe whether the opponent commits to Anaguma. Develop the left silver through 67 and 56 to 45; if a floating enemy rook restricts the silver, combine its pressure with the knight’s attack instead of forcing the silver forward.

paragraphs.ja: 玉は４八で待機し、桂跳ねの前に角の成り込みを防ぎます。▲２五桂で角を追い、角が退いたら▲６五歩で角道を開きます。角筋が穴熊の銀を縛る間に▲１三桂成で端へ食い込みます。金を５八に寄せるなど最低限の守りも必要で、相手が端歩を受ける場合には同じ攻めを無理に選びません。
paragraphs.en: Place the king on 48 before jumping the knight, reducing the bishop’s promotion threat. Knight-25 attacks the bishop; after it retreats, Pawn-65 opens Black’s bishop diagonal toward Anaguma. The diagonal restricts the defending silver while Knight-13 promotes into the edge. Add essential defense, such as Gold-58, before committing. If the opponent answers the early edge pawn, reassess the formation rather than forcing the same attack.

question.ja: ▲６五歩を突く狙いは？
question.en: Why push Pawn-65 after the bishop retreats?

answer.ja: 角道を開き、穴熊の銀の動きを制限します。
answer.en: To open the bishop diagonal and restrict Anaguma’s silver.

title.ja: ノーマル三間飛車 トマホーク：局面の狙い
title.en: Tomahawk against Static Rook Anaguma: the plan on the board

notes.ja: ２五桂で角を追い、１三への桂成を狙う。
notes.en: Knight-25 chases the bishop and threatens promotion on 13.

notes.ja: 端へ桂を成らせる。開いた角道が穴熊の銀を縛る。
notes.en: Promote the knight into the edge; the opened bishop diagonal restricts Anaguma’s silver.

title.ja: 石田流の基本、最初の駒組み
title.en: Ishida: choosing the first formation

paragraphs.ja: 石田流は７筋の歩を７五まで伸ばし、飛車を７六へ浮いて構える三間飛車です。相手が角道を開けた出だしなら、３手目７五歩から目指せます。△４二玉には▲６六歩で角交換を防ぎ、△８四歩には▲７八飛、△８五歩には▲７六飛と対応します。
paragraphs.en: Ishida advances the seventh-file pawn to 75 and uses a floating rook on 76. Against an opening bishop-diagonal move, Black can aim for it with the third-move Pawn-75. After White’s King-42, Pawn-66 closes the diagonal; answer Pawn-84 with Rook-78 and Pawn-85 with Rook-76. The floating rook provides the eighth-file defense that the undeveloped bishop otherwise cannot supply.

paragraphs.ja: 相手が初めから△８四歩を突く場合は、７五歩を急がず飛車を回る必要があります。角道を開けたままなら早石田の乱戦へ分岐し、角交換と４五角への応手が必要です。通常の石田流では角道を閉じて美濃を作り、７七桂と９七角の本組み、または７七角型を選びます。
paragraphs.en: If White starts with Pawn-84, develop the rook rather than automatically pushing Pawn-75. Keeping the bishop diagonal open leads toward Early Ishida and sharp bishop-exchange variations, including Bishop*45. For the quieter formation, close the diagonal, build Mino, and choose between the full setup with Knight-77 and Bishop-97 or a Bishop-77 setup. The opponent’s opening moves determine which route is practical.

question.ja: ▲７六飛は何を守る配置ですか？
question.en: What does the floating rook on 76 defend?

answer.ja: 相手の８筋からの歩と飛車の攻めに備えます。
answer.en: It helps meet White’s pawn and rook attack on the eighth file.

title.ja: 石田流の基本、最初の駒組み：局面の狙い
title.en: Ishida: choosing the first formation: the plan on the board

notes.ja: ７筋の歩を伸ばし、浮き飛車の場所を空ける。
notes.en: Advance the seventh-file pawn to clear a square for the floating rook.

notes.ja: ７六飛で８筋の攻めを受ける石田流の形。
notes.en: Rook-76 forms Ishida’s defense against an eighth-file attack.

title.ja: 石田流本組みの組み方
title.en: Building Full Ishida

paragraphs.ja: 石田流本組みでは、飛車７六、桂７七、銀６七、角９七を組み合わせます。相手の６三銀は７四への攻めを抑えるため、まず美濃囲いを作ります。玉を２八へ移す前に左金を５八へ寄せると、角交換後の飛車金両取りの隙を減らせます。
paragraphs.en: Full Ishida combines Rook-76, Knight-77, Silver-67, and Bishop-97. White’s Silver-63 restrains a seventh-file attack, so begin by building Mino rather than forcing a pawn exchange. Move the left gold to 58 before completing the king’s journey to 28. Connecting the gold reduces bishop-fork targets if White opens the center and exchanges bishops during development.

paragraphs.ja: 美濃ができたら銀より先に７七桂を跳ねます。銀を先に動かすと、△６五歩から角道を開けられ、８八の角を取られる危険があります。桂を置いた後に銀を６七へ運び、９六歩から９七角とすれば本組みです。７六の飛車は８筋の守りも担うため、早い７四飛は相手の８六歩を許します。
paragraphs.en: After Mino, develop Knight-77 before moving the left silver. Moving the silver first can leave the bishop on 88 vulnerable to White’s central pawn break. Then bring the silver to 67 and use Pawn-96 followed by Bishop-97. The rook on 76 still defends the eighth file: an early excursion to 74 can allow White to strike with Pawn-86.

question.ja: 銀より先に７七桂を跳ねる理由は？
question.en: Why develop Knight-77 before the left silver?

title.ja: 石田流本組みの仕掛け
title.en: Full Ishida: choosing the pawn break

paragraphs.ja: 石田流本組みの仕掛けは、相手の銀の位置で選びます。５三銀型は７筋の守りが薄く、７四歩の交換から飛車を７五へ引き、８五の歩を取って飛車交換を迫れます。相手が飛車を８四に浮くなら、８六歩から同飛とぶつける攻めを考えます。
paragraphs.en: Choose Full Ishida’s pawn break by locating White’s defensive silver. A silver on 53 leaves the seventh file less protected: exchange on 74, retreat the rook to 75, and consider taking the pawn on 85 to offer a rook trade. If White floats the rook to 84 instead, Pawn-86 can create another rook challenge. Each plan depends on safe drop squares after the exchange.

paragraphs.ja: ６三銀型には、銀を５六へ進めて６五歩から仕掛けます。同歩に銀で取れば角筋と協力して６筋を押さえ、桂で取れば成り捨てから７筋を狙います。相手が６筋へ飛車を回したときは、単純な銀交換で侵入を許さず、６四銀などで角の支えを使います。飛車だけでなく角と桂の働きも比較します。
paragraphs.en: Against Silver-63, advance Silver-56 and break with Pawn-65. Recapturing with the silver controls the sixth file with bishop support; recapturing with the knight can lead to a promotion sacrifice and renewed seventh-file pressure. If White shifts the rook to the sixth file, a simple silver exchange may allow invasion. Consider a bishop-supported silver on 64 and compare the activity of all attacking pieces.

title.ja: 早石田の基本（升田式石田流）
title.en: Masuda-style Early Ishida

paragraphs.ja: 升田式石田流は、角道を開けたまま７五歩と７八飛で速攻を準備し、先に玉を４八へ移します。玉を動かすことで、後の９五角が王手になる筋を避けます。相手が居玉で飛車先を交換したときは、７四歩と角交換から９五角の王手飛車を狙えます。
paragraphs.en: Masuda-style Early Ishida keeps the bishop diagonal open, develops Pawn-75 and Rook-78, and moves the king to 48 before attacking. Moving the king removes a potential checking Bishop*95 against Black. If White exchanges the rook pawn while leaving the king at home, Black can push Pawn-74, exchange bishops, and use Bishop*95 to fork king and rook. That tactic depends on White accepting the seventh-file pawn.

paragraphs.ja: ゆっくりした駒組みには、７四歩の交換後に５五角を打ち、飛車と銀を狙います。△７三銀は飛車を守る粘り強い応手で、先手は７四飛からさらに圧力をかけます。飛車を切って馬を作る変化もありますが、自陣への飛車打ちや相手玉の位置を確認します。奇襲が成立しない応手もあるため、相手の受けを無視して同じ筋を繰り返しません。
paragraphs.en: Against slower development, Bishop*55 after the seventh-file exchange attacks rook and silver. White’s Silver-73 defends the rook, so Black continues with Rook-74. Some variations sacrifice the rook to obtain an active horse, but inspect enemy rook drops and the king’s position before committing. This is a tactical opening with specific conditions, and an informed defense changes the continuation.

title.ja: 石田流 4→3戦法
title.en: Fourth-to-Third File Rook

paragraphs.ja: ４→３戦法は、後手がまず４二飛で４筋を守り、玉を７二まで移してから３二飛へ振り直す作戦です。最初から三間飛車にすると、角交換後の６五角が４三と８三の両方を狙います。４二飛は４三を、７二の玉は８三を守るため、振り直す順番に意味があります。
paragraphs.en: Fourth-to-Third File Rook begins with White’s rook on 42, moves the king to 72, and then switches the rook to 32. An immediate Third File Rook can allow Bishop*65 after a bishop exchange, threatening promotion on both 43 and 83. The rook initially defends 43, and the king’s development adds protection to 83. The preliminary Fourth File Rook therefore solves a specific move-order problem.

paragraphs.ja: ３五歩と３四飛で浮き飛車の石田流を目指し、必要なら４四歩で角道を閉じます。先手が２四歩から急ぐ場合は、飛車が進出したときの角交換が反撃になります。相手の銀が玉に守られていると角の両取りは成立しないため、２二飛で飛車交換を迫る方法へ切り替えます。攻めの形だけでなく銀の支えも確認します。
paragraphs.en: Pawn-35 and Rook-34 create a floating Ishida-style rook; Pawn-44 can close the bishop diagonal for quieter development. If Black attacks early with Pawn-24, exchanging bishops as the rook advances provides counterplay. A bishop fork may fail when Black’s king protects the silver, so White can instead challenge the rook on 22. Check the silver’s actual support before selecting the tactical response.
